abstract: Whether wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) contains dietary information remains unknown. We trained a language model on 1.1M meals to predict meal descriptions from PPG, aligning PPG to text. PPG nontrivially predicts meal content; predictability decreases for PPGs farther from meals. This transfers to dietary tasks: PPG increases AUC by 11% for intake and satiety across held-out and independent cohorts, with gains robust to text degradation. Wearable PPG may enable passive dietary monitoring.
zh_abstract: 可穿戴光电容积脉搏波（PPG）是否包含饮食信息尚不清楚。我们在110万餐数据上训练了一个语言模型，通过将PPG与文本对齐，从PPG预测餐食描述。PPG能够非平凡地预测餐食内容；对于距离进餐时间更远的PPG，可预测性下降。这可迁移到饮食相关任务：在留出队列和独立队列中，PPG使摄入量和饱腹感的AUC提高了11%，且在文本质量下降时增益依然稳健。可穿戴PPG有望实现被动式饮食监测。

title: A gait foundation model for prediction of multisystem health phenotypes from 3D skeletal motion
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 基于3D骨骼运动预测多系统健康表型的步态基础模型
summary: 利用单深度相机记录的3,328名深度表型成人5项运动任务的3D骨骼数据，训练步态基础模型，通过学习嵌入预测涉及18个身体系统的健康表型。
key_points: 输入为单深度相机采集的3D骨骼运动
学习嵌入表现优于人工设计的步态特征
预测握力、睡眠质量等多系统表型
reason: Nature Medicine基础模型研究、队列较大；摘要未见外部验证，略降
abstract: Gait is increasingly recognized as a vital sign, yet current approaches treat it as a symptom of specific pathologies rather than a systemic biomarker. Here we developed a gait foundation model for three-dimensional skeletal motion, which was recorded via a single-depth camera during 5 motor tasks, from 3,328 deeply phenotyped adults. Our purpose was to capture the full pattern of a person’s movement and use it to predict health phenotypes such as grip strength and sleep quality across 18 body systems. Gait is conventionally described by engineered features (for example, calculated measurements such as cadence and stride length), which may fail to capture the fine detail of how a person moves. Our model instead translates movement into learned embeddings: sets of numbers that describe how all body joints move together over time. Learned embeddings outperformed engineered features for prediction of age (Pearsonʼs r = 0.69), body mass index (r = 0.91) and visceral adipose tissue area (r = 0.83), and embeddings significantly predicted 1,887 of 3,210 tested phenotypes. Relative to a baseline model using age, body mass index, visceral adipose tissue and height alone, gait embeddings improved prediction in all 18 systems in males and 17 of 18 in females, as well as prediction of clinical diagnoses and medication use. Anatomical ablation analyses revealed that leg dynamics dominated metabolic and frailty predictions, and torso dynamics encoded sleep and lifestyle phenotypes. These findings establish gait as an independent, multisystem biosignal, motivating integration of gait analysis into routine clinical assessment as a scalable, passive vital sign.
zh_abstract: 步态日益被视为一项生命体征，但目前的方法将其视为特定病理的症状，而非系统性生物标志物。在此，我们针对三维骨骼运动开发了一个步态基础模型，这些运动数据来自3,328名经过深度表型分析的成年人，在5项运动任务中通过单个深度相机记录。我们的目的是捕捉一个人运动的完整模式，并用其预测涵盖18个身体系统的健康表型，如握力和睡眠质量。传统上，步态由工程化特征（例如步频和步幅等计算得到的测量值）描述，这些特征可能无法捕捉一个人运动方式的细微细节。我们的模型则将运动转化为习得的嵌入（embeddings）：即描述所有身体关节如何随时间共同运动的一组数字。在预测年龄（Pearson r = 0.69）、体重指数（r = 0.91）和内脏脂肪组织面积（r = 0.83）方面，习得嵌入优于工程化特征；并且嵌入显著预测了3,210个受检表型中的1,887个。相对于仅使用年龄、体重指数、内脏脂肪组织和身高的基线模型，步态嵌入在男性的全部18个系统以及女性的18个系统中的17个中改善了预测，同时也改善了对临床诊断和用药情况的预测。解剖学消融分析显示，腿部动态在代谢和衰弱预测中占主导地位，而躯干动态编码了睡眠和生活方式表型。这些发现确立了步态作为一种独立的多系统生物信号，促使将步态分析纳入常规临床评估，作为一种可扩展的被动式生命体征。

title: A statistical framework for evaluating the repeatability and reproducibility of large language models.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 评估大语言模型可重复性与再现性的统计框架
summary: 研究提出统计框架及Python包llmReproScore，从语义和内部两个维度用四项指标量化LLM输出的可重复性与再现性，并以USMLE诊断推理为例应用。
key_points: 借鉴FDA术语定义四项指标
分语义变异与token生成确定性两维度
发布Python包llmReproScore

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Systematic evaluation of variability in large language model (LLM)-generated outputs is critical for assessing their reliability. We developed a general statistical framework and Python package (llmReproScore) for quantifying the repeatability and reproducibility of LLM outputs. Following US Food and Drug Administration terminology, our framework establishes four metrics for quantifying LLM repeatability and reproducibility along two dimensions: semantic and internal. Semantic metrics quantify variability in the meaning of LLM-generated outputs, whereas internal metrics quantify variability in token-generation certainty. We validated these metrics, and as an illustrative use case, applied them to diagnostic reasoning outputs generated across LLMs and prompting strategies using US Medical Licensing Examination questions and 90 real-world rare disease cases from the Undiagnosed Diseases Network. Validation results showed that semantic scores aligned with human ratings (Spearman ρ = 0.88 for repeatability and 0.66 for reproducibility) and confirmed that internal metrics capture variability in token-generation certainty. In the illustrative use case, LLM repeatability was generally not associated with accuracy, suggesting that LLM output variability and accuracy capture distinct dimensions of model performance. The proposed metrics can be used to characterize LLM output variability and systematically compare models, prompts, and generation settings. These comparisons can inform more rigorous selection of LLM configurations based on repeatability and reproducibility. We developed and validated generalizable metrics for quantifying LLM output variability. The proposed metrics can complement accuracy-based evaluation to inform experimental design and support more rigorous comparison and selection of models, prompts, and generation settings.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 系统评估大语言模型（LLM）生成输出的变异性，对于评估其可靠性至关重要。我们开发了一个通用统计框架和 Python 软件包（llmReproScore），用于量化 LLM 输出的可重复性（repeatability）和可再现性（reproducibility）。参照美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的术语，我们的框架沿语义和内部两个维度建立了四项用于量化 LLM 可重复性和可再现性的指标。语义指标量化 LLM 生成输出在含义上的变异性，而内部指标量化词元（token）生成确定性方面的变异性。我们对这些指标进行了验证，并作为示例应用，利用美国医师执照考试（US Medical Licensing Examination）题目以及来自未确诊疾病网络（Undiagnosed Diseases Network）的 90 例真实世界罕见病病例，将其应用于不同 LLM 和提示策略生成的诊断推理输出。验证结果显示，语义评分与人工评分一致（可重复性的 Spearman ρ = 0.88，可再现性为 0.66），并证实内部指标能够反映词元生成确定性的变异性。在示例应用中，LLM 的可重复性总体上与准确性无关，提示 LLM 输出变异性与准确性反映的是模型性能的不同维度。所提出的指标可用于刻画 LLM 输出变异性，并系统比较模型、提示和生成设置。这些比较可为基于可重复性和可再现性、更严谨地选择 LLM 配置提供依据。我们开发并验证了可推广的、用于量化 LLM 输出变异性的指标。所提出的指标可补充基于准确性的评估，为实验设计提供参考，并支持对模型、提示和生成设置进行更严谨的比较和选择。

abstract: [Nucleic acids research] The BioImage Archive (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/bioimage-archive) is EMBL-EBI's flagship resource for life sciences image data. It serves as a deposition database for biological images across scales from near-atomic through to whole organisms, and across imaging modalities. The Archive's mission is to support the reproducibility of quantitative results based on imaging, support methods development including modern deep-learning-based approaches, and allow large-scale reanalysis of image data. Across the Archive's ecosystem, we provide access to over 11 PB of image data. Recent developments in underpinning infrastructure now allow interactive exploration, visualization, and streaming access to a subset of the Archive's data using the new OME-Zarr file format, and will ultimately provide access to all of EMBL-EBI's archived image data, including data from the Electron Microscopy Public Image Archive. Migration of all holdings and a unified submission system are in progress.
zh_abstract: [核酸研究 Nucleic acids research] 生物图像档案库（BioImage Archive，https://www.ebi.ac.uk/bioimage-archive）是EMBL-EBI面向生命科学图像数据的旗舰资源。它是一个生物图像存储数据库，涵盖从近原子尺度到完整生物体的各种尺度以及各种成像模态。该档案库的使命是支持基于成像的定量结果的可重复性，支持包括基于现代深度学习方法在内的方法开发，并允许对图像数据进行大规模重新分析。在整个档案库生态系统中，我们提供超过11 PB图像数据的访问。基础设施方面的最新进展现已允许使用新的OME-Zarr文件格式对档案库中的部分数据进行交互式探索、可视化和流式访问，并将最终提供对EMBL-EBI所有已存档图像数据（包括来自电子显微镜公共图像档案库 Electron Microscopy Public Image Archive 的数据）的访问。所有馆藏的迁移以及统一提交系统正在进行中。

title: Emergence of polarization in networks of large language model agents.
zh_title: 大模型智能体网络中极化现象的涌现
summary: 模拟数千个LLM智能体构成的网络，多种骨干模型下观察到社交网络自发形成及观点极化。
key_points: 覆盖GPT-3.5、GPT-4o、Llama-3等模型
智能体自发形成同质性聚类网络
通过LLM对话更新观点并出现极化
reason: Nature Commun.大规模智能体社会模拟，多模型对比，命中偏好
abstract: [Nature communications] Rapid advances in large language models (LLMs) have empowered autonomous agents to generate social networks, communicate, and form shared and diverging opinions on political issues. However, our understanding of their collective behaviours and underlying mechanisms remains incomplete. In this paper, we simulate networked systems involving thousands of LLM agents across different backbone models (GPT-3.5, GPT-4o, ChatGLM, Llama-3, and DeepSeek-V3), in which agents interact through LLM-guided conversations and update their opinions over time, resulting in the emergence of opinion polarization. We discover that these agents spontaneously develop their own social network with properties characteristic of human social networks, such as homophilic clustering. The collective opinions of these LLM agents evolve in ways that exhibit behavioural patterns consistent with social phenomena and mechanisms widely discussed in empirical studies of human behaviour and opinion-dynamics models. This consistency suggests that LLM agents can serve as a valuable synthetic testbed for exploring hypothetical intervention strategies in networked LLM-agent systems. Using this testbed, we further examine the effects of a range of network- and individual-level interventions, such as promoting more diverse interactions and reducing confirmation bias. Overall, this work not only sheds light on subtle opinion dynamics and collective behaviour of LLM agents from a network perspective, but also demonstrates their potential for testing hypotheses about opinion dynamics and intervention strategies.
zh_abstract: [Nature communications] 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展使自主智能体能够生成社交网络、相互交流，并就政治议题形成共同或分歧的观点。然而，我们对其集体行为及其潜在机制的理解仍不完整。本文模拟了包含数千个LLM智能体的网络系统，涉及不同的底层模型（GPT-3.5、GPT-4o、ChatGLM、Llama-3和DeepSeek-V3），其中智能体通过LLM引导的对话进行互动并随时间更新其观点，最终出现观点极化。我们发现，这些智能体自发形成了自己的社交网络，具有人类社交网络的典型特征，如同质性聚类。这些LLM智能体的集体观点的演化方式所表现出的行为模式，与人类行为实证研究和观点动力学模型中广泛讨论的社会现象和机制相一致。这种一致性表明，LLM智能体可作为有价值的合成试验平台，用于探索网络化LLM智能体系统中的假设性干预策略。利用该试验平台，我们进一步考察了一系列网络层面和个体层面干预的效果，例如促进更多样化的互动和减少确认偏误。总体而言，这项工作不仅从网络视角揭示了LLM智能体微妙的观点动力学和集体行为，也展示了其在检验观点动力学假设和干预策略方面的潜力。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Detection and Characterization of Colorectal Polyps during Colonoscopy: Evidence and Future Perspectives.
zh_title: AI辅助结肠镜息肉检测与特征判断：证据与展望
summary: 综述AI在结肠镜息肉检测与定性中的证据，从回顾性验证发展到实时随机试验、meta分析与指南讨论。
key_points: CADe可改善腺瘤检出率等替代指标
研究重心转向实时随机试验

reason: 综述类，上限6档；证据汇总有信息量
abstract: [Gut and liver] Colonoscopy is central to colorectal cancer prevention because it enables early detection and removal of premalignant lesions. However, lesions can still be missed, and endoscopic differentiation of neoplastic from nonneoplastic polyps remains variable, particularly for diminutive lesions. The potential of artificial intelligence (AI) as a supportive technology for improving both polyp detection and characterization during colonoscopy has therefore been investigated. Since early studies of convolutional neural network-based computer-aided detection (CADe), the focus has shifted from retrospective image-based validation to real-time randomized trials, meta-analyses, and clinical guideline discussions. Accumulating evidence suggests that CADe improves surrogate detection outcomes, including the adenoma detection rate (ADR), polyp detection rate, adenomas per colonoscopy, and adenoma miss rate. Although a higher ADR is associated with a lower risk of postcolonoscopy colorectal cancer, it remains unknown whether the incremental improvement in the ADR achieved by CADe translates into lower postcolonoscopy colorectal cancer incidence or colorectal cancer-related mortality. Recent multicenter data further support the effectiveness of real-time CADe systems in improving detection-related outcomes, while also indicating that benefit varies with lesion characteristics and user experience. In parallel, computer-aided diagnosis (CADx) has been developed to assist the optical characterization of colorectal polyps, particularly for diminutive lesions and potential resect-and-discard or diagnose-and-leave strategies. CADx systems using white-light imaging and structured high-confidence diagnostic rules show promise, but the clinical implementation of CADx remains less mature than that of CADe. This review summarizes current evidence for AI-assisted polyp detection and characterization and discusses limitations and future directions for integrating CADe and CADx into human-centered colonoscopy practices.
zh_abstract: [Gut and liver] 结肠镜检查能够早期发现并切除癌前病变，是结直肠癌预防的核心。然而，病变仍可能被漏诊，内镜下区分肿瘤性与非肿瘤性息肉的结果仍存在差异，尤其是对于微小病变。因此，人们研究了人工智能（AI）作为辅助技术，在结肠镜检查中改善息肉检出和特征判定的潜力。自基于卷积神经网络的计算机辅助检测（CADe）的早期研究以来，研究重点已从回顾性的基于图像的验证转向实时随机试验、荟萃分析和临床指南讨论。累积证据表明，CADe可改善替代性检出结局，包括腺瘤检出率（ADR）、息肉检出率、每次结肠镜检查的腺瘤数和腺瘤漏诊率。尽管较高的ADR与结肠镜检查后结直肠癌的较低风险相关，但CADe所带来的ADR增量改善是否转化为较低的结肠镜检查后结直肠癌发病率或结直肠癌相关死亡率，目前仍未知。近期的多中心数据进一步支持实时CADe系统在改善检出相关结局方面的有效性，同时也表明获益随病变特征和使用者经验而异。与此同时，计算机辅助诊断（CADx）已被开发用于辅助结直肠息肉的光学特征判定，尤其针对微小病变以及潜在的切除后丢弃（resect-and-discard）或诊断后留置（diagnose-and-leave）策略。使用白光成像和结构化高置信度诊断规则的CADx系统显示出前景，但CADx的临床应用成熟度仍低于CADe。本综述总结了AI辅助息肉检出和特征判定的现有证据，并讨论了将CADe和CADx整合到以人为本的结肠镜检查实践中的局限性和未来方向。

title: Clinical predictions using artificial intelligence in neurosurgery and its subspecialties: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

abstract: [British journal of neurosurgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) models for clinical prediction are proliferating across neurosurgery, but their aggregate discriminative performance, distribution along the care pathway and methodological quality are unclear. We systematically reviewed and meta-analysed these studies in neurosurgery and its subspecialities along with their risk of bias appraisal. We performed a PRISMA search on PubMed and Ovid for peer-reviewed original studies (2015-2026) using AI to predict a clinical outcome in neurosurgical populations. Metrics (primary- AUC; secondary- accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, c-index) were pooled using random effects modelling, overall, by subspeciality and care-pathway stage. Each study was classified as diagnostic, prognostic or forecasting and was assigned an evidence level. Clinical prediction task sub-stratification analysis was performed. Risk-of-bias was assessed using PROBAST. PROSPERO registered: CRD420261436614. 1063 studies were included. Across 451 (42.2%) studies reporting AUC, pooled discrimination was 0.86 (95% CI: 0.849-0.862), ranging from 0.84 (spine) to 0.87 (neuro-oncology), with extreme heterogeneity (I2 98.6%, τ2=0.27; 95% prediction interval: 0.68-0.94). Performance varied by clinical pathway stage, highest for diagnosis, grading and molecular tasks and lowest for post-operative tasks; pre-diagnosis, pre-operative and intra-operative applications were sparse, and treatment models were confined to neuro-oncology. Only 51 studies (4.8%) were using prospective data with external validation, whereas 619 (58%) rested on internal validation alone or no validation. 89% studies were at high risk-of-bias, driven by the analysis domain. Pooled discrimination was unchanged (AUC: 0.86%) when restricted to externally validated or non-high-risk studies. AI models report high performance across all the neurosurgical subspecialities, concordant across AUC, accuracy, sensitivity and specificity and robust to risk-of-bias stratification. Performance is highest for imaging-anchored diagnostic tasks and lowest at decision-facing post-operative stage. However, the literature is dominated by optimism-prone, internally-validated and poorly calibrated models with extreme heterogeneity. External validation, calibration analysis and reporting guidelines adherence remain prerequisites for clinical adoption.

title: kinGEMs: A robust and scalable framework for resource-constraint models through stochastic tuning of deep learning-predicted kinetic parameters.

abstract: [PLoS computational biology] The construction of accurate enzyme-constrained genome-scale models (ecGEMs) remains a critical challenge in systems biology, limited by sparse kinetic data and the need for biologically meaningful representations. This work presents an integrated framework combining CPI-Pred, a deep learning model to predict kinetic parameters (kcat) from sequence and compound embeddings, with kinGEMs, a pipeline to incorporate these uncertainty-aware parameters into ecGEMs for metabolic optimization. By leveraging representations at multiple scales, the approach captures sequence, structure, and kinetic data to enhance model generalizability and accuracy. Rigorous benchmarking demonstrates the framework's capability to predict growth rates and fluxes that are consistent with experimental observations and measured proteome fractions, reduce median flux variability by several folds, and yield better-constrained metabolic models by explicitly accounting for the uncertainty inherent in ML-predicted kinetic parameters. kinGEMs successfully generated ecGEMs for 93 models spanning a phylogenetically diverse set of organisms including Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria, mycobacteria, parasitic protists, fungi, and mammalian cell lines. These innovations breakdown the barrier to application of ecGEMs to non-model organisms and open new avenues for metabolic engineering and synthetic biology in more industrially relevant hosts.
zh_abstract: [PLoS computational biology] 构建准确的酶约束基因组规模模型（ecGEMs）仍是系统生物学中的关键挑战，其受限于稀疏的动力学数据以及对具有生物学意义的表示的需求。本研究提出一个整合框架，将 CPI-Pred 与 kinGEMs 相结合：CPI-Pred 是一种深度学习模型，可根据序列和化合物嵌入预测动力学参数（kcat）；kinGEMs 是一条流程，用于将这些考虑不确定性的参数纳入 ecGEMs 以进行代谢优化。通过利用多尺度表示，该方法整合序列、结构和动力学数据，以提高模型的泛化能力和准确性。严格的基准测试表明，该框架能够预测与实验观察结果及实测蛋白质组分数一致的生长速率和通量，将通量变异性中位数降低数倍，并通过明确考虑机器学习预测的动力学参数固有的不确定性，获得约束更好的代谢模型。kinGEMs 成功为 93 个模型生成了 ecGEMs，这些模型涵盖系统发育上多样的生物，包括革兰氏阴性菌和革兰氏阳性菌、分枝杆菌、寄生原生生物、真菌和哺乳动物细胞系。这些创新打破了将 ecGEMs 应用于非模式生物的障碍，并为在更具工业相关性的宿主中开展代谢工程和合成生物学开辟了新途径。

title: Learning a patient world model for health system simulation in intensive care
zh_title: 面向ICU卫生系统仿真的患者世界模型学习
summary: 提出基于纵向EHR训练神经网络患者世界模型，在MIMIC-IV上训练并冻结，用于不同ICU运营仿真场景。
key_points: 从纵向EHR学习共享的患者轨迹表征
在MIMIC-IV训练后冻结并耦合ICU日历
支持跨场景的卫生系统仿真问题
reason: 医疗世界模型新方法，预印本且仅见MIMIC，中档并上调
abstract: Designing healthcare strategies requires anticipating their clinical and operational consequences before implementation, a task that often relies on health system simulation. Such a simulation necessitates modeling how patient states evolve and generate care demands. However, conventional approaches typically tailor compact state transitions to a single policy question and omit history-dependent dynamics, thus requiring the redefinition of states and transitions when there is a new question that entails different clinical information. We propose to learn a patient world model from longitudinal EHRs using a neural network to provide a shared clinical representation of patient trajectories that can serve simulation questions across scenarios. Taking ICU operations as an example, we train the model on MIMIC-IV, freeze it, and couple its time-queryable predictions to shared ICU calendars, resources, and queues via scenario-specific mappings, so that one model renders admission demand, care tasks, and discharge proposals across simulations evaluating ICU bed capacity, care dispatch, and post-ICU transfer capacity. Experiments show that our model matches Markov and semi-Markov comparators in aggregate occupancy and directional responses to capacity and dispatch policies. It also reproduces policy gains from replayed observed trajectories. For patients entering the same support state from different prior trajectories, the learned representation captures a 24-h recovery difference (-6.4 predicted versus -6.7 observed percentage points), a contrast missed by compact state models, which propagates into distinct simulated care demand, queue burden, and bed use. These results indicate that a learned world model of patient dynamics has the potential to replace question-specific state models, allowing new care policies to be evaluated by reconfiguring the scenario without model rebuilding.
zh_abstract: 设计医疗保健策略需要在实施前预判其临床和运营后果，这一任务通常依赖卫生系统模拟。此类模拟需要对患者状态如何演变并产生照护需求进行建模。然而，传统方法通常针对单一政策问题定制紧凑的状态转移，并忽略依赖于病史的动态变化，因此当出现涉及不同临床信息的新问题时，需要重新定义状态和转移。我们提出利用神经网络从纵向电子健康记录（EHR）中学习患者世界模型，以提供患者轨迹的共享临床表示，可用于跨场景的模拟问题。以 ICU 运营为例，我们在 MIMIC-IV 上训练该模型并将其冻结，再通过特定场景的映射，将其可按时间查询的预测与共享的 ICU 日历、资源和队列相耦合，使得同一个模型能够在评估 ICU 床位容量、照护调度和 ICU 后转出容量的各项模拟中生成入院需求、照护任务和出院建议。实验表明，我们的模型在总体占用率以及对容量和调度政策的方向性响应方面与马尔可夫和半马尔可夫对照模型相当。它还能重现由回放的观察轨迹所得到的政策收益。对于从不同既往轨迹进入同一支持状态的患者，所学习的表示捕捉到了24小时恢复差异（预测 -6.4 对观察 -6.7 个百分点），而紧凑状态模型则遗漏了这一差异，该差异会传导为模拟中不同的照护需求、队列负担和床位使用。这些结果表明，学习得到的患者动态世界模型有可能取代针对特定问题的状态模型，使得通过重新配置场景而无需重建模型即可评估新的照护政策。

title: NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
zh_title: NPCBench：鼻咽癌多模态诊疗路径推理的临床学徒式基准
summary: 提出面向鼻咽癌的多模态基准，含4,777个条目及100例患者的诊疗路径队列，评估模型在整条诊疗路径中的联合正确性。
key_points: 含4,777个组件与咨询条目
100例患者队列、417项评分任务
按病程评估诊断与诊疗联合正确性
reason: 新的专病多模态基准预印本，规模中等
abstract: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. To close this gap, we introduce NPCBench, a clinical apprenticeship benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). NPCBench mirrors specialist training, from guideline and foundational knowledge to case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and open-ended consultation. It contains 4,777 component and consultation items and a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored diagnostic and care tasks. The episode-level evaluation tests whether diagnostic and care answers are jointly correct within a care pathway. By linking stepwise tasks to patient-level care trajectories, NPCBench evaluates whether models ground decisions in visual evidence, interpret changes in patient state, and meet clinical requirements in consultation. Across 30 evaluated models, we observe a composition gap: strong performance on individual tasks does not ensure jointly correct diagnostic and care answers for the same patient. Among 21 multimodal models, strict CarePath success reaches at most 23%. Paired controls and physician calibration further examine evidence grounding, longitudinal revision, and consultation judging. Overall, NPCBench broadens the evaluation of medical artificial intelligence beyond static question-answering paradigms to an apprenticeship-oriented assessment of clinical workflows, thereby offering a testbed for evidence-based and temporally coherent reasoning in oncology care.
zh_abstract: 当前的医学基准通常将临床能力拆解为孤立的事实性问题、单图像任务或静态病例摘要。这些测试对单个答案评分，但较难反映模型能否将亚专科知识与多模态证据整合，并在整个诊疗过程中追踪患者病情。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了NPCBench，一个针对鼻咽癌（NPC）的临床学徒式基准。NPCBench模拟专科培训，从指南和基础知识，到病例规划、纵向复盘、CarePath整合以及开放式会诊。它包含4,777个组件和会诊题目，以及一个包含100名患者的CarePath队列，其中有417项计分的诊断与诊疗任务。病程（episode）层面的评估检验在同一诊疗路径中诊断和诊疗答案是否同时正确。通过将分步任务与患者层面的诊疗轨迹相联系，NPCBench评估模型是否以视觉证据为依据做出决策、是否能解读患者状态的变化，以及在会诊中是否满足临床要求。在评估的30个模型中，我们观察到“组合差距”：单项任务的强劲表现并不能保证同一患者的诊断与诊疗答案同时正确。在21个多模态模型中，严格的CarePath成功率最高仅达23%。配对对照和医生校准进一步考察了证据依据、纵向修订和会诊评判。总体而言，NPCBench将医学人工智能的评估从静态问答范式拓展到面向学徒式的临床工作流程评估，从而为肿瘤诊疗中循证且时间连贯的推理提供了测试平台。

title: Learning Constraints in Protein Evolution beyond Known Substitution Frequencies.
zh_title: 超越已知替换频率的蛋白质进化约束学习
summary: 基于ESM2编码器训练深度学习模型，预测蛋白质序列进化中氨基酸替换的速率、位置和类型，检验序列是否含有超出常规替换统计的上下文信息。
key_points: 以ESM2编码器为基础
预测替换的速率、位置与性质
探究超出保守性统计的进化信息
reason: 蛋白质语言模型的新颖应用，摘要信息有限，属值得一看档
abstract: [Molecular biology and evolution] During the evolution of protein sequences, amino acid substitutions follow broad patterns that are well established, such as those induced by the physico-chemical properties of residues or the position of sites along the sequence. While these deviations from random changes have been exploited for practical applications, such as to simulate protein evolution or to score protein alignments, they are too general to predict the precise evolution of individual protein sequences. To investigate whether protein sequences contain contextual information about their subsequent evolution beyond that captured by conventional substitution statistics and evolutionary conservation, we trained deep learning models based on an Evolutionary Scale Modelling (ESM2) encoder to predict the rate, the position and the nature of the amino-acid substitutions in the evolution of ancestral sequences and compared their performance to simpler and explainable heuristics. Our results show that predicting the rate of amino acid changes is achieved equally well by deep learning and by using evolutionary information in outgroup sequences. This suggests that the protein sequence does not contain information that significantly improves the predictions for this task. On the opposite, we show that deep learning models predict the position of these substitutions more accurately than statistics-based baselines. Predictions of the nature of substitutions largely outperform baselines, with over 37% accuracy overall. We observe that rapidly evolving sequences are harder to predict and substitutions preferentially occur between chemically similar amino acids. Interestingly, predictive information is predominantly contained within a local sequence context of 16 residues. These findings indicate that the nature of substitutions in protein evolution is partly governed by predictive rules that remain to be discovered through a more accurate modelling that could describe evolutionary trajectories based on sequence context alone.
zh_abstract: [分子生物学与进化] 在蛋白质序列的进化过程中，氨基酸替换遵循一些已被充分确立的总体规律，例如由残基的理化性质或位点在序列中的位置所引起的规律。尽管这些偏离随机变化的现象已被用于实际应用，如模拟蛋白质进化或对蛋白质比对进行评分，但它们过于笼统，无法预测单个蛋白质序列的精确进化。为了探究蛋白质序列是否包含超出传统替换统计和进化保守性所能反映的、关于其后续进化的上下文信息，我们训练了基于进化尺度建模（Evolutionary Scale Modelling，ESM2）编码器的深度学习模型，用以预测祖先序列进化中氨基酸替换的速率、位置和性质，并将其表现与更简单且可解释的启发式方法进行比较。我们的结果表明，深度学习与利用外类群序列中的进化信息在预测氨基酸变化速率方面效果相当。这提示蛋白质序列本身并不包含能显著改善该任务预测的信息。相反，我们发现深度学习模型对这些替换位置的预测比基于统计的基线更准确。对替换性质的预测大幅优于基线，总体准确率超过37%。我们观察到，快速进化的序列更难预测，且替换更倾向于发生在化学性质相似的氨基酸之间。有趣的是，预测性信息主要包含在16个残基的局部序列上下文中。这些发现表明，蛋白质进化中替换的性质部分受尚待发现的预测规则支配，通过更精确的建模，有望仅基于序列上下文来描述进化轨迹。

title: Deciphering the regulatory code of RNA inosine through enzymatic precision mapping and an explainable deep learning model.
zh_title: 酶学精准定位与可解释深度学习解析RNA肌苷调控密码
summary: 开发REX-seq肌苷检测方法和InoDREAM深度学习模型，用于解析A-to-I RNA编辑的位点选择机制。
key_points: REX-seq结合EndoV切割与XRN-1外切酶
InoDREAM为可解释预测框架
用于绘制A-to-I编辑组图谱
reason: 实验方法加可解释模型的基础研究，有新意
abstract: [Cell discovery] Adenosine-to-inosine (A-to-I) RNA editing is one of the most abundant RNA modifications and is involved in multiple critical biological processes; however, the precise localization of inosine and the mechanisms governing their selective editing remain incompletely understood. Integrating high-accuracy detection technologies with deep learning models can accelerate our understanding of the selective positioning and functional implications of A-to-I editing. To address these challenges, this study simultaneously developed RNA inosine sequencing by endonuclease V (EndoV) and XRN-1 (REX-seq), a highly sensitive and accurate detection method for inosine sites, and Inosine Deep Residual Enhanced Attention Model (InoDREAM), a predictive deep learning framework. REX-seq combines EndoV cleavage specificity with XRN-1 exonuclease activity to enable comprehensive A-to-I editome profiling while maintaining accurate gene expression quantification. Using this method, we identified 590,249 high-confidence inosine sites in HEK293T cells, including 84,645 novel sites. Leveraging the high-confidence A-to-I editing sites identified by REX-seq, we developed InoDREAM, which successfully predicted multiple regulatory proteins that exhibit specific binding affinity to A-to-I edited transcripts while simultaneously identifying disease-associated mutation sites and relevant cis-regulatory elements that are functionally linked to RNA editing events. These findings provide novel mechanistic insights into both the molecular regulation of RNA editing and its pathophysiological implications in disease development.
zh_abstract: [Cell discovery] 腺苷到肌苷（A-to-I）RNA 编辑是最丰富的 RNA 修饰之一，参与多种关键生物学过程；然而，肌苷的精确定位及其选择性编辑的调控机制仍未完全阐明。将高准确度检测技术与深度学习模型相结合，可加速我们对 A-to-I 编辑的选择性定位及其功能意义的理解。为应对这些挑战，本研究同时开发了基于核酸内切酶 V（EndoV）和 XRN-1 的 RNA 肌苷测序方法（REX-seq）——一种高灵敏度、高准确度的肌苷位点检测方法，以及预测性深度学习框架 Inosine Deep Residual Enhanced Attention Model（InoDREAM）。REX-seq 将 EndoV 的切割特异性与 XRN-1 核酸外切酶活性相结合，可在保持基因表达定量准确的同时实现全面的 A-to-I 编辑组图谱分析。利用该方法，我们在 HEK293T 细胞中鉴定出 590,249 个高置信度肌苷位点，其中包括 84,645 个新位点。基于 REX-seq 鉴定的高置信度 A-to-I 编辑位点，我们开发了 InoDREAM，其成功预测了多种对 A-to-I 编辑转录本具有特异性结合亲和力的调控蛋白，同时识别出与 RNA 编辑事件在功能上相关联的疾病相关突变位点和相关顺式调控元件。这些发现为 RNA 编辑的分子调控及其在疾病发生发展中的病理生理学意义提供了新的机制见解。

title: Multimodal Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Modeling
zh_title: MedHiVE：面向3D医学视觉语言建模的分层专家混合
summary: 预印本提出MedHiVE，用两级软混合专家按解剖尺度路由视觉与文本token，并结合报告衍生的解剖级对比对齐，用于3D医学影像。
key_points: 两级SMoE按解剖尺度组织
视觉与文本token均参与路由
结合解剖级对比学习对齐
reason: 3D医学VLM新方法预印本，命中偏好；证据有限
abstract: Medical 3D scans and reports are inherently hierarchical, with diagnostic cues concentrated in specific anatomical regions across multiple levels of organization. Yet, most medical vision-language models ignore this structure and fail to focus on clinically relevant anatomy. We introduce MedHiVE, which combines hierarchical vision-language Soft Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) with contrastive learning to jointly model fine-grained anatomy and global scan context. To our knowledge, MedHiVE is the first framework to route both vision and text tokens through a two-level SMoE hierarchy organized by anatomical scale, coupling this with report-derived anatomy-level contrastive alignment for 3D medical imaging. This replaces the direct region-text alignment of statically pooled features and vision-only hierarchical routing of prior work with dynamic, slot-based cross-modal information flow across anatomical scales. MedHiVE operates via a two-level, learnable token-routing mechanism, where local image and text features are first routed through a local SMoE and then fused by a global SMoE into unified multimodal representations. Contrastive learning aligns both anatomy-level and global vision-language representations in a unified space. Pre-trained on 25,000+ CT scans with anatomical supervision, MedHiVE consistently surpasses 11 state-of-the-art methods across 6 datasets on 3 tasks: segmentation, classification, and detection, demonstrating the importance of hierarchical modeling. The code for MedHiVE is at github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHiVE.

title: Evaluation of PainWaive: a consumer-grade EEG headset for remote EEG monitoring and neurofeedback research in chronic pain

zh_title: PainWaive消费级脑电头戴设备在慢性疼痛远程监测中的评估
summary: 80名参与者完成静息态记录，将2通道PainWaive头戴设备与64通道研究级EEG对比，评估频段功率与峰值alpha频率的信度及跨设备一致性。
key_points: 80名参与者，睁眼与闭眼两种静息条件
与64通道LiveAmp比较，评估ICC与SEM%
面向慢性疼痛的远程神经反馈与长期监测
reason: 小样本设备验证，参与者非患者，AI关联弱，属增量档
abstract: Abstract Affordable home-based electroencephalography (EEG) headsets could widen access to EEG assessment, but require rigorous validation before research or clinical use. Here, we evaluated a custom-developed 2-channel sensorimotor headset (PainWaive) intended for remote neuro-feedback and longitudinal monitoring in chronic pain. Eighty participants (47 female; mean age 24.0 years, SD 7.9) completed two resting-state sessions with PainWaive and a research-grade 64-channel EEG system (LiveAmp), under eyes-open (EO) and eyes-closed (EC) conditions. Alpha, beta and theta power and peak alpha frequency (PAF) were derived from homologous sensorimotor channels (C1/C2). Relative reliability was quantified with intraclass correlation coefficients (ICCs), absolute reliability with SEM%, and cross-device consistency with between-device ICCs and Pearson correlations of overall spectral shape. ICCs/correlations were interpreted using pre-specified thresholds: fair 0.20–0.39, moderate 0.40–0.59, good 0.60–0.79, excellent ≥0.80. PainWaive and LiveAmp showed comparable absolute reliability across metrics (similar SEM%). Under EC, PainWaive reliability was excellent for alpha (0.81), theta (0.85) and PAF (0.94), and good for beta (0.72). Under EO, reliability was excellent for alpha (0.82), good for beta and PAF (0.61–0.72), and moderate for theta (0.59). Spectral-shape correlations between devices were excellent (r>0.90). Cross-device ICCs were good under EC for alpha/theta/PAF (ICC=0.66–0.77) though fair for beta (0.35). Under EO, ICCs were good for alpha (0.62), moderate for PAF (0.53), and fair for beta/theta (0.26–0.32). To assess performance under real-world use, we additionally analysed 2 clinical samples of individuals (total n = 8) with chronic pain who each completed 20 home-based neurofeedback sessions using PainWaive (160 sessions total). Within-session stability was good-to-excellent across metrics (ICCs>0.72). Overall, our findings suggest PainWaive is a reliable tool for the assessment of EEG metrics, supporting its use in research and clinical applications.
zh_abstract: 摘要 经济实惠的家用脑电图（EEG）头戴设备可扩大EEG评估的可及性，但在用于研究或临床之前需要严格验证。在此，我们评估了一款定制开发的2通道感觉运动头戴设备（PainWaive），其用于慢性疼痛的远程神经反馈和纵向监测。80名参与者（47名女性；平均年龄24.0岁，标准差7.9）在睁眼（EO）和闭眼（EC）条件下，使用PainWaive和研究级64通道EEG系统（LiveAmp）完成了两次静息态记录。α、β和θ功率以及α峰值频率（PAF）源自同源感觉运动通道（C1/C2）。相对信度用组内相关系数（ICC）量化，绝对信度用SEM%量化，跨设备一致性则用设备间ICC及整体频谱形状的Pearson相关来评估。ICC/相关系数按预先设定的阈值解释：一般0.20–0.39，中等0.40–0.59，良好0.60–0.79，优秀≥0.80。PainWaive与LiveAmp在各指标上显示出相当的绝对信度（SEM%相似）。在EC条件下，PainWaive的信度对α（0.81）、θ（0.85）和PAF（0.94）为优秀，对β（0.72）为良好。在EO条件下，信度对α（0.82）为优秀，对β和PAF（0.61–0.72）为良好，对θ（0.59）为中等。设备间频谱形状相关性为优秀（r>0.90）。在EC条件下，α/θ/PAF的跨设备ICC为良好（ICC=0.66–0.77），而β为一般（0.35）。在EO条件下，α的ICC为良好（0.62），PAF为中等（0.53），β/θ为一般（0.26–0.32）。为评估真实使用情境下的表现，我们另外分析了2个临床样本（共n = 8名慢性疼痛患者），每人使用PainWaive完成20次居家神经反馈训练（共160次）。各指标的单次训练内稳定性为良好至优秀（ICC>0.72）。总体而言，我们的研究结果提示PainWaive是评估EEG指标的可靠工具，支持其在研究和临床应用中的使用。

title: Towards a foundation model for raw nanopore signal through discrete tokenization
zh_title: 通过离散分词构建原始纳米孔信号基础模型

abstract: Nanopore sequencing reads nucleic acids as changes in ionic current that carry information beyond the base sequence. Self-supervised pretrained models have advanced genomic sequence modeling and single-cell analysis, but remain underexplored for raw nanopore signals, which are continuous and lack a native token vocabulary. Here we present Brieno, an approach combining reconstruction-based tokenization through residual vector quantization with a Transformer for contextual representation learning. We pretrain the Transformer using masked-token prediction on raw nanopore signals from 118 million reads. With frozen or fine-tuned features, the model identifies species without requiring reference genomes. It complements Dorado by accurately classifying reads left unclassified in native-barcode demultiplexing, approaches Dorado's basecalling performance across six genomes, and exceeds Dorado's specialized 5-methylcytosine model as well as a dedicated 6-methyladenine caller. Brieno also supports accurate CpG methylation detection with limited labeled data. Across tasks, pretrained contextual representations improve downstream performance over non-pretrained baselines and generalize across sequencing runs. Together, these findings support self-supervised pretraining as a basis for transferable representations of raw nanopore signals.
zh_abstract: 纳米孔测序将核酸读取为离子电流的变化，这些变化所携带的信息超出碱基序列本身。自监督预训练模型已推动了基因组序列建模和单细胞分析的发展，但对于原始纳米孔信号——其为连续信号且缺乏天然的词元（token）词表——仍探索不足。在此，我们提出 Brieno，这是一种将基于重建的词元化（通过残差向量量化实现）与用于上下文表征学习的 Transformer 相结合的方法。我们在来自 1.18 亿条读段的原始纳米孔信号上，采用掩码词元预测对 Transformer 进行预训练。使用冻结或微调后的特征，该模型无需参考基因组即可识别物种。它对 Dorado 形成补充，能够准确分类在原生条形码拆分中未被 Dorado 分类的读段；在六个基因组上的碱基识别性能接近 Dorado；并且超越了 Dorado 专用的 5-甲基胞嘧啶模型以及一种专用的 6-甲基腺嘌呤识别工具。Brieno 还支持在标注数据有限的情况下准确检测 CpG 甲基化。在各项任务中，预训练的上下文表征相较于未预训练的基线提升了下游性能，并可在不同测序运行之间泛化。总之，这些发现支持将自监督预训练作为获得原始纳米孔信号可迁移表征的基础。

abstract: Using electronic health record (EHR) data to answer clinical research questions is challenging. It requires understanding the research question, finding relevant information across different sources, and combining that information to produce meaningful results. We developed an agentic large language model (LLM) pipeline that decomposes investigator-authored requests into source-specific tasks, generates and executes SQL on EHR, integrates structured and unstructured EHR evidence, and applies study-specific clinical note adjudication. We evaluated this workflow against data analyst-identified cohorts across 50 pediatric orthopedic clinical data query requests. Of these, 43 were included in manual-review-adjusted performance analyses. The median adjusted positive predictive value, sensitivity among patients identified by either approach, and corresponding F1 score were 0.93 (95% CI, 0.88-0.98), 0.92 (95% CI, 0.90-0.95) and 0.90 (95% CI, 0.87-0.94), respectively. These findings support the feasibility of translating natural-language research intent into executable, autonomous multi-stage EHR workflows.

abstract: [Neuro-oncology advances] Therapy-induced tissue alterations complicate intraoperative diagnosis of recurrent central nervous system (CNS) tumors. We evaluated stimulated Raman histology (SRH) combined with convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for rapid tumor detection and classification. In this bicentric observational study, fresh tissue from patients undergoing resection or stereotactic biopsy for suspected recurrent CNS tumors was imaged with fiber-laser-based SRH. CNN1 performed binary tumor/non-tumor prediction and CNN2 histotype classification. CNN1 was evaluated against blinded neuropathologist SRH consensus and CNN2 against the final integrated histopathological diagnosis. Of 382 acquired SRH images, 262 images from 143 patients were included. CNN1 achieved an AUC of 0.975 (95% CI, 0.95-1.00) for tumor detection. An exploratory cohort-derived tumor probability threshold of ≥59 increased specificity from 70.7% to 92.0% while maintaining 95.2% sensitivity and identifying 71.4% of radiation necrosis samples. Among 212 images in treatment subgroup analysis, CNN1 accuracy did not differ significantly across prior-treatment groups (overall 90.1%; P = .080). CNN2 accuracy declined from 61.8% after surgery alone to 39.0% after surgery, radiotherapy, and medical treatment (χ2 = 6.04, P = .049). Multimodal therapy was independently associated with lower odds of correct CNN2 prediction (adjusted OR, 0.10 [95% CI, 0.02-0.39]; P = .001 and 0.04 [95% CI, 0.01-0.20]; P < .001). 120/382 images (31.4%) were of insufficient diagnostic quality; application of the quality control threshold would have rejected 84/120 (70.0%). CNN1 maintained high tumor/non-tumor discrimination across treatment subgroups when image quality was sufficient, whereas CNN2 entity-classification performance declined with increasing treatment intensity. Reliable SRH-based diagnosis in recurrent tumors requires validated image-quality control measures and model adaptation to recurrent disease.

abstract: [Arthroplasty (London, England)] Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine-learning methods are increasingly discussed in relation to robotic-assisted total knee arthroplasty (TKA). However, robotic assistance, computer navigation, and AI-based prediction represent distinct functions that are often conflated under the single label "AI-assisted robotic TKA," obscuring the state of evidence for each. This review clarifies these distinctions and maps the current evidence for AI-related functions across the TKA pathway, keeping AI prediction evidence analytically separate from robotic execution evidence at the level of each clinical function. We performed a critical narrative review and evidence map of peer-reviewed literature relevant to robotic-assisted TKA, navigation-assisted TKA, AI/ML prediction models, digital planning, implant sizing, intraoperative decision support, postoperative monitoring, implementation, and economic evaluation. Evidence was interpreted according to clinical function, comparator structure, validation status, and translational maturity. Because the available literature is methodologically and conceptually heterogeneous, quantitative pooling and formal comparative-effectiveness claims were not attempted. Robotic-assisted and navigation-assisted TKA have the most mature evidence base for improving technical precision, particularly implant positioning and radiographic alignment. In contrast, AI/ML evidence is concentrated mainly in adjacent pathway functions, including radiographic interpretation, implant-sizing prediction, patient-selection support, dissatisfaction prediction, outcome modelling, perioperative risk stratification, and postoperative monitoring. Direct clinical evidence demonstrating that AI-enabled robotic TKA provides incremental patient-level benefit beyond conventional robotic assistance remains limited. Current studies are constrained by inconsistent terminology, short follow-up, limited external validation, incomplete reporting of AI components, heterogeneous outcomes, cost uncertainty, and uncertain generalizability across patient populations and healthcare settings. AI should not currently be treated as a single validated surgical intervention in TKA. Rather, it represents a family of emerging pathway-level functions that may support preoperative planning, intraoperative decision support, patient selection, risk communication, and longitudinal recovery monitoring. abstract: [Current atherosclerosis reports] Blood pressure (BP) and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) are leading cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk factors yet remain suboptimally controlled. Digital health technologies may help bridge the gap between guideline recommendations and improved cardiovascular (CV) outcomes. We review digital health interventions for hypertension and dyslipidemia management. Mobile health (mHealth) interventions, including Corrie, LINKED-BP, Hello Heart, and Mass General Brigham platforms, demonstrate meaningful improvements in BP and LDL-C, particularly when paired with clinical support. In contrast, low-intensity text messaging alone produces modest or inconsistent benefits. Electronic Health Record (EHR)-based alerts can support therapy intensification but require thoughtful integration and clinician co-design. Artificial Intelligence (AI) may identify nonadherence and automate prescription refills, although further study is needed. Equitable implementation among high-risk and underserved populations remains essential. Digital health can promote treatment adherence, patient activation, earlier intervention, and access to care, with potential to improve CVD prevention at scale.

abstract: [PloS one] Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death worldwide. Sudden cardiac death (SCD) accounts for roughly 50% of all cardiac deaths. The electrocardiogram (ECG) is widely used for diagnosing cardiac disease. However, the complexity of interpretation limits the ECG's efficacy. Modern deep learning methods can assist clinicians in diagnosis. We applied Neural Architecture Search (NAS) to identify optimal deep learning architectures for classifying cardiac arrhythmias with ECGs. We applied the Differentiable Architecture Search strategy to an AutoFormer search and trained, validated, and tested the resulting model on the PhysioNet Challenge 2021 (PC21) dataset (n = 88,253 from three continents). We optimised hyperparameters on the NAS output, exploring input patch size, class weighting, and loss function. The PC21 metric and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) are the performance metrics. The NAS converged towards minimal architectural configurations (embedding dimension: 384, depth: 4, self-attention heads: 4, MLP ratio: 1) with a validation and test PC21 metric of 0.66 (PC21 winner: 0.63). The NAS-created network achieved an AUROC of 0.97 and a PC21 metric of 0.72 during testing (PC21 winner: 0.69). We tested the PC21 winner architecture (1D-convolutional neural network with attention mechanism) without the attention mechanism and with the NAS-suggested architecture of 4 self-attention heads (instead of 8). The architecture without the attention mechanism performed similarly to the one with 8 self-attention heads (AUROC: 0.90, PC21 metric: 0.69). The architecture with 4 self-attention heads scored an AUROC of 0.91 and improved the PC21 metric to 0.71. The attention mechanism visualisation for two SCD-related arrhythmias (premature ventricular contractions and prolonged QT-interval) showed more clinically relevant attention for the 4-self-attention-head architectures. We interpret architectural simplicity as driving performance in arrhythmia classification. The self-attention mechanism can autonomously abstract clinical representations, simplifying clinical deployment by eliminating the need for an explicit feature-extraction pipeline.
zh_abstract: [PloS one] 心血管疾病是全球首要死因。心脏性猝死（SCD）约占全部心脏性死亡的50%。心电图（ECG）被广泛用于诊断心脏疾病，但解读的复杂性限制了其效能。现代深度学习方法可以辅助临床医生诊断。我们应用神经架构搜索（NAS）来确定用于通过心电图分类心律失常的最优深度学习架构。我们将可微分架构搜索策略应用于 AutoFormer 搜索，并在 PhysioNet Challenge 2021（PC21）数据集（n = 88,253，来自三大洲）上对所得模型进行训练、验证和测试。我们在 NAS 输出的基础上优化超参数，探索了输入补丁大小、类别权重和损失函数。性能指标为 PC21 指标和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。NAS 收敛于最小化的架构配置（嵌入维度：384，深度：4，自注意力头数：4，MLP 比率：1），验证和测试的 PC21 指标为 0.66（PC21 优胜者：0.63）。NAS 生成的网络在测试中 AUROC 为 0.97，PC21 指标为 0.72（PC21 优胜者：0.69）。我们测试了 PC21 优胜架构（带注意力机制的一维卷积神经网络），分别去除注意力机制，以及采用 NAS 建议的4个自注意力头（而非8个）。去除注意力机制的架构与8个自注意力头的架构表现相近（AUROC：0.90，PC21 指标：0.69）。4个自注意力头的架构 AUROC 为 0.91，PC21 指标提高到 0.71。针对两种与 SCD 相关的心律失常（室性早搏和 QT 间期延长）的注意力机制可视化显示，4个自注意力头的架构具有更具临床相关性的注意力。我们认为架构的简洁性推动了心律失常分类的性能。自注意力机制可以自主抽象出临床表征，无需显式的特征提取流程，从而简化临床部署。

abstract: [JMIR biomedical engineering] Simulated patient systems are essential in nursing education but face actor scarcity, instructor burden, cost, and disrupted continuity where in-person simulation cannot be sustained. Existing large language model (LLM)-based systems address these issues but treat the dialogic partner-the AI nurse-as a static prompt or unspecialized model, compromising data collection quality and pedagogical applicability. We report (1) the construction of 2 specialized fine-tuned models, NURSE-ONE (AI nurse) and PATIENT-ONE (AI-simulated patient), via a 5-step bidirectional fine-tuning pipeline; (2) their evaluation using Berelson content analysis validated by independent human coders; (3) an exploratory third-party evaluation by nursing faculty; and (4) the design of a coexistence simulation ecosystem supporting 3 operating modes, including offline disaster preparedness applicability. On a single consumer-grade graphics processing unit (NVIDIA RTX 4090; 24 GB video random access memory), the multimodal base model gemma4-E4B-it was fine-tuned via low-rank adaptation in five steps: (1) a 251-scenario base from 29 institutionally authored nursing care plans and 20 items from the 115th Japanese National Nursing Examination; (2) a provisional dialogue system (AutoGen v18, maxmsg=25) to collect training dialogues; (3) NURSE-ONE fine-tuning across 3 training volume conditions (245, 735, and 1225 cases); (4) 4-condition Berelson comparison; and (5) PATIENT-ONE fine-tuning on NURSE-ONE-generated dialogues with a 3-condition comparison. Interrater reliability was confirmed by 2 independent nursing experts (196 blinded utterances, κ=0.770) and corroborated by 2 LLM raters (κ=0.742). Ten nursing faculty evaluated 3 coexistence modes in a working web user interface (21-item rubric; item-level content validity index=1.00). Four-condition Berelson analysis (χ215=42.0, P<.001) identified the 735-case nurse-side condition (open question rate=21.5%) as NURSE-ONE; information collection rate reached 15.5% (~4× baseline) at 1225 cases. PATIENT-ONE A/B/C analysis (χ210=11.8, P=.30) showed no significant category shift but the lowest response length variability (SD 24.5) and highest information-providing rate (47.9%) at 735 cases, adopted as PATIENT-ONE. The 2 adapters appeared to operate on different axes-qualitative questioning style on the nurse side and quantitative response stability on the patient side-a preliminary observed pattern we term functional asymmetry, pending replication. abstract: [IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics] Spontaneous Echo Contrast (SEC), characterized by smoke-like dynamic echogenicity in trans esophageal echocardiography (TEE), serves as a critical imaging biomarker for assessing thromboembolic risk. However, current diagnostic approaches depend on manual interpretation or regression-based algorithms, which are labor-intensive, prone to inconsistency, and limited in generalizability. To address these challenges, we propose SECNet, an end-to-end deep learning framework for auto mated SEC detection in TEE videos. SECNet incorporates two key components: (1) a region-of-interest segmentation module that accurately localizes SEC-prone cardiac structures while suppressing surrounding noise; and (2) a spa tiotemporal feature extraction module that captures both temporal dynamics and spatial distribution of SEC. These modules are linked through a novel differentiable mask guided bridging mechanism that enables joint optimization of localization and representation learning. Trained on a clinical dataset of 1,106 annotated TEE videos, SECNet achieves 93.7% accuracy and a 90.0% F1-score, outper forming the compared methods by 3.1-23.3 percentage points in accuracy. An auxiliary experiment on EchoNet Dynamic further demonstrates the applicability of the architecture to a related echocardiographic video-analysis task. This study supports standardized and reproducible SEC assessment to assist thromboembolic risk evaluation in clinical workflows.

abstract: [Science advances] Conversation is a core component of human social life. Many influential theories treat conversation as a linear system, i.e., the sum of its parts. However, linear accounts of semantic entrainment lose explanatory power at their upper limits: Discussing perfectly aligned opinions becomes boring. We propose an alternate account that considers the multiscale organization of semantic similarity over the course of a conversation, as indexed by pink noise. Here, we test whether pink noise can be found in interlocutors' conavigated trajectories through semantic space. Not only is pink noise present, but its strength predicts positive conversation outcomes like enjoyment and connection, increases with practice, and is reflected in a large language model's representation of conversation quality. These results demonstrate an important role for scale-free dynamics in characterizing successful conversation.
zh_abstract: [Science advances] 对话是人类社会生活的核心组成部分。许多有影响力的理论将对话视为一个线性系统，即各部分之和。然而，关于语义同步（semantic entrainment）的线性解释在其上限处丧失了解释力：讨论观点完全一致的话题会变得乏味。我们提出另一种解释，考虑对话过程中语义相似性的多尺度组织，并以粉红噪声（pink noise）作为指标。在此，我们检验在对话者共同导航的语义空间轨迹中是否能发现粉红噪声。结果不仅存在粉红噪声，而且其强度可预测积极的对话结果（如愉悦感和联结感），随练习而增强，并且在大语言模型对对话质量的表征中也有所体现。这些结果表明，无标度动力学在刻画成功对话方面具有重要作用。

abstract: [Psychiatric services (Washington, D.C.)] Despite widespread concern about the use of artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, and Google Gemini), especially among individuals with mental health problems, little to no empirical data about such use have been obtained from those experiencing severe mental illness. The authors aimed to characterize the prevalence and perceptions of chatbot use among adults being discharged from an inpatient psychiatric unit. Adults (N=100) pending discharge from an inpatient unit were surveyed about their chatbot use, including general (i.e., non-mental health) use, use specifically for mental health purposes, and perceived helpfulness or harms of and barriers to use. Overall, 61% of the participants reported using an AI chatbot, with 30% using such chatbots specifically for mental health purposes. Chatbot use was most common among patients ages <39 years, who accounted for 87% of the chatbot users and for 90% of those who had used a chatbot for mental health purposes. Among those who had used a chatbot for mental health purposes, most (80%) rated the chatbots positively, perceiving these tools as nonjudgmental and accessible, and 37% had used a chatbot during a psychiatric crisis. Disclosure of this use to care providers was uncommon, with only 13% of those who used chatbots for mental health purposes reporting openly discussing such use with their providers, and 37% actively intending not to disclose such use. AI chatbot use among individuals hospitalized for psychiatric care was found to be common, clinically relevant, and largely undisclosed, highlighting the need for clinicians to ask their patients about chatbot use.

abstract: [Zeitschrift fur medizinische Physik] PET image quality degradation due to positron range effects in high-energy positron-emitting radionuclides such as Gallium-68 (68Ga) can be mitigated by applying positron range correction (PRC). Deep learning (DL) models have been shown to improve image quality by reducing image noise. This study aimed to evaluate a DL model for simultaneous denoising and 68Ga-specific PRC in clinical [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TOC PET scans. Three different U-Net-based DL models were trained to map reduced-count PET images reconstructed without PRC (25%, 33%, or 50% of acquired counts) to full-count PET images reconstructed with tissue-independent PRC (FC-PRC). The generated reduced-count-enhanced images (RCE-25%, RCE-33%, RCE-50%) were evaluated using the mean standardized uptake value (SUVmean) in liver and lung, noise levels in liver, and maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) and contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR) of soft tissue lesions. Three experienced nuclear medicine physicians assessed the overall image quality (OIQ), overall diagnostic confidence (ODC), and lesion detectability (sensitivity, specificity, accuracy). Compared to FC-PRC, RCE-33% and RCE-50% exhibited similar noise, whereas RCE-25% showed substantial residual noise. CNR was reduced for RCE-33% (-5.6%, p=0.001) and RCE-25% (-8.0%, p 90%). The proposed DL-based approach achieved comparable noise and image quality down to 50% of counts. Although it did not outperform the reconstruction-based PRC, its benefit lies in simultaneous denoising and PRC in a single step.

abstract: [Journal of controlled release : official journal of the Controlled Release Society] The translation of nanomedicines remains constrained by persistent bottlenecks, including complex design parameters, unpredictable in vivo behavior, and low diagnostic accuracy. Artificial intelligence (AI), with its advanced data processing and learning algorithms, offers new solutions to these challenges by learning from heterogeneous data and supporting decision-making throughout nanomedicine development. This review summarizes the AI methods and modeling workflows relevant to nanomedicine and surveys their applications in rational nanomaterial design, prediction of in vivo fate and nano-bio interactions, theranostic imaging analysis, and formulation and manufacturing optimization. This review further discusses the main barriers that currently limit translation, which largely concern data, model reliability, and computational cost. Future progress will depend on better data resources, more generalizable and interpretable models, and closer integration of AI with experimental and mechanistic approaches. We believe that through these advances, AI-enabled nanomedicine will ultimately achieve more reliable and translatable outcomes.

abstract: [Progress in biophysics and molecular biology] CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing has transformed biomedical research and is advancing toward clinical translation. The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) offers improved precision in guide RNA design, off-target prediction, and delivery optimization. This review synthesizes recent advances in CRISPR-Cas9 for medical applications, covering core mechanisms, engineered variants, base and prime editors, and therapeutic applications including CAR T-cell and CAR-NK engineering, genetic disorders, infectious diseases, and regenerative medicine. Delivery strategies are evaluated with emphasis on AI-driven optimization. AI applications are highlighted across deep learning architectures for guide RNA design, AI-designed nucleases such as OpenCRISPR-1, structure-guided and AI-assisted design of compact high-fidelity SaCas9 variants, reinforcement learning for pipeline optimization, and roles in CAR T-cell therapy and safety assessment. Safety challenges are examined, including off-target effects, chromosomal rearrangements, immunogenicity, and regulatory concerns. Future directions emphasize multi-scale modeling, explainable AI, clinical validation, and integration with synthetic biology, single-cell sequencing, organoids, and nanomaterials. The convergence of AI and CRISPR-Cas9 holds substantial potential for personalized medicine.

abstract: [iScience] Accurate discrimination of benign and malignant breast lesions is essential for early diagnosis, yet remains challenging due to lesion heterogeneity and interobserver variability in ultrasound assessment. We developed a deep learning (DL) framework integrating dual inverted bottleneck blocks (Dual-IB), adaptive hierarchical feature fusion, and knowledge distillation (KD) for breast ultrasound lesion classification. The model was trained and evaluated on public datasets and validated on an independent external cohort to assess its generalizability. Results demonstrated superior performance compared with baseline methods and resident radiologists, while maintaining robust performance across diverse datasets and imaging conditions. On the external validation dataset, the model achieved the best performance, with an accuracy (Acc) of 92.64% and an F1-score of 92.37%. Furthermore, class activation mapping (CAM) visualizations revealed focused and anatomically plausible attention patterns within lesion regions, aiding interpretation and suggesting its potential to assist in breast ultrasound lesion classification.
