abstract: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.
zh_abstract: 跨就诊陪伴患者的基于 LLM 的医疗助手，需要一种能在患者临床状态变化时保持其正确的记忆。我们考察了五种记忆系统在纵向医疗对话中的错误，发现三类反复出现的原因：检索到的证据给出过时的状态、包含他人的健康事实，或缺少回答所依赖的安全性事实。我们提出了 MedGraph，一种针对这三类情况构建的图记忆。其构建过程从每次会话中提取带日期的事实，将每条事实归属于其所描述的人，并将用药、诊断和测量记录链接成保留既往状态的链。检索时，将患者的链作为整体单元进行排序，按问题所询问的时间点读取每条链，并补充原始对话文本；患者档案会在每个问题中列出所有已记录的安全性事实。在 MedMemoryBench 上，无论使用 GPT 还是 Qwen 骨干模型，MedGraph 的总体准确率均最高，分别比五个基线中最强者高 10.5 和 10.4 个百分点，并且在 GPT 设置下记忆构建和回答效率较高。

title: OraRefer: Segmentation-Guided Multi-Photograph Fusion for Oral Cancer Screening with Guaranteed Patient-Level Sensitivity
zh_title: OraRefer：分割引导多图融合的口腔癌筛查
summary: 提出患者级口腔癌筛查模型，融合同一患者多张手机照片与风险因素，并通过阈值提供有限样本敏感度保证。
key_points: 分割引导基础模型读取每张照片
融合多图与风险因素做患者级转诊
在714名患者3000张照片上评估
reason: 预印本，新颖方法，样本中等，无明确外部验证
abstract: Oral cancer and the oral potentially malignant disorders (OPMD) that can precede it are visible on the oral mucosa, which makes smartphone photographs a promising tool for screening. Deep learning models for this task classify individual photographs. However, screening refers patients, not photographs: a patient is usually photographed several times, and the referral decision must miss no more than a set share of patients with disease. We propose OraRefer, a patient-level screening model that reads each photograph with a segmentation-guided foundation model that conditions its class decision on the predicted lesion, combines all photographs of a patient with risk factors, and refers through a threshold with a finite-sample sensitivity guarantee. The model localizes the mouth itself, so inference needs no annotation. On 3000 photographs of 714 patients, patient-level fusion reaches an AUROC of 0.919 and outperforms attention-based multiple-instance learning. At a 90% sensitivity target, OraRefer detects 95% of patients with OPMD or cancer and misses 3 of 61 patients with cancer, at a specificity of 0.610. Because the threshold is calibrated without retraining, each clinic can set its own guaranteed operating point on a local calibration sample.

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
zh_title: 异构认知与生物医学知识图谱上的大模型基准：图谱接地与幻觉缓解
summary: 在五个知识图谱上评测五种LLM的多跳推理，发现通用模型整体优于领域模型，知识图谱接地可降低幻觉率。
key_points: 评测GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro等五种模型
覆盖DrugBank、NeuroSynth等五个知识图谱
图谱接地降低各模型幻觉率
reason: 有新意的基准评测预印本，证据有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在生物医学和认知神经科学中的应用日益增多，但其在异质知识图谱（KG）上进行可靠推理的能力仍不明确。我们在五个知识图谱（DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map 和 GDPKG）上对五种大语言模型（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen 和 BioGPT）进行了基准测试。我们引入了多层级查询数据集，以评估在知识图谱感知（基于图谱）和知识图谱无关两种条件下的推理深度和事实准确性。标注者间一致性较高，Cohen's kappa 为 0.781（范围：0.753-0.807），Fleiss' kappa 为 0.77。结果显示，通用模型，尤其是 GPT-5.1 和 Gemini 2.0 Pro，在多跳和高层级推理任务上总体优于领域专用模型，但随着查询复杂度增加，性能下降。知识图谱接地（grounding）降低了所有被评估模型的幻觉率。与我们最初的假设相反，在没有图谱接地的情况下，领域专用模型在专业任务上并未持续优于通用模型。这些发现凸显了将广泛的语言模型能力与结构化领域知识相结合的价值。我们根据任务复杂度和计算约束，为选择 LLM-KG 整合策略提供了实用指导，并讨论了面向个体化医疗、认知障碍诊断和可解释 AI 的混合神经符号架构。

title: USB Gym: A Gymnasium Testbed for Closed-Loop Ultrasound View Matching
zh_title: USB Gym：闭环超声切面匹配的Gymnasium测试平台
summary: 构建基于公开CT模拟超声的测试平台，可替换分割器、控制器与奖励模块，评估20种已发表方法组合。
key_points: 由患者CT模拟超声并生成器官纹理
三个可替换模块共纳入20种方法
以位姿oracle作为参考上限
reason: 预印本，新基准/仿真平台，规模有限
abstract: Background and Objective: Our main goal is ultrasound guidance: moving a probe until its image matches a target view. Published methods for each part of a guide are evaluated in separate simulators. We asked whether these methods, combined into one guide, are good enough. Methods: We built USB Gym, a testbed whose standard engine simulates ultrasound from public patient CT, with a network drawing organ textures from CT labels. Its guide has three replaceable parts (slots), an organ segmenter, a controller and a reward, which received 20 published methods, each run on the same 60 episodes of six held-out patients. In each slot, a published method replaced ours only if detectably better on these patients. The better of this combination and our original guide on 20 new CTs is the benchmark baseline. A pose oracle, reading the exact probe pose available only in simulation, set the reference. The results below are exploratory. Results: On these CTs, the probe started on average 16.0 mm from the target view; the pose oracle brought it to 1.5 mm. Of the results known when the combination was fixed, only an image-similarity reward (SSIM) was slightly but detectably better, so the combination was our guide with that reward. This combination was the benchmark baseline, ending at 13.7 mm (16% of the oracle's progress). Conclusions: Combining untuned published methods with ours did not guide the probe near the target view; the task remains under-explored. The testbed accepts new methods; no guide was tested on hardware.
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】我们的主要目标是超声引导：移动探头直至其图像与目标切面匹配。已发表的针对引导各部分的方法是在各自独立的模拟器中评估的。我们探讨了将这些方法组合成一个引导系统后是否足够好。【方法】我们构建了 USB Gym，这是一个测试平台，其标准引擎根据公开的患者 CT 模拟超声，并由一个网络依据 CT 标签生成器官纹理。其引导系统有三个可替换部分（插槽）：器官分割器、控制器和奖励函数，共接入 20 种已发表的方法，每种方法均在六名留出患者的相同 60 个回合上运行。在每个插槽中，仅当已发表方法在这些患者上可检出地优于我们的方法时，才替换我们的方法。该组合与我们原始引导系统二者中较优者在 20 份新 CT 上的表现作为基准基线。一个姿态预言机（pose oracle）读取仅在模拟中可得的精确探头姿态，作为参照。以下结果为探索性结果。【结果】在这些 CT 上，探头平均起始位置距目标切面 16.0 mm；姿态预言机将其降至 1.5 mm。在组合确定时已知的结果中，仅有图像相似性奖励（SSIM）略微但可检出地更优，因此该组合为采用该奖励的我们的引导系统。该组合即为基准基线，最终距离为 13.7 mm（达到预言机进展的 16%）。【结论】将未经调优的已发表方法与我们的方法组合，并未能引导探头接近目标切面；该任务仍未得到充分探索。该测试平台可接纳新方法；尚无引导系统在硬件上进行测试。

title: Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework
zh_title: 卵巢癌多组学合成数据：基于生物学的评估框架
summary: 提出面向配对RNA表达与CNV合成数据的生物学启发、患者互斥评估框架，并应用于DECIDER高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列。
key_points: 重点是评估标准而非新架构
评估RNA与CNV的保真度和一致性
改造三种基于VAE的多组学整合架构
reason: 有新意的评估框架预印本，单一队列，证据有限
abstract: Paired multi-omic cancer cohorts are costly to assemble and difficult to share, motivating synthetic cohorts as a complementary resource. As generative model development accelerates, we shift the focus from proposing yet another architecture to defining evaluation criteria that determine whether synthetic data preserve biologically relevant structure. We introduce a biology-informed and patient-disjoint framework for evaluating the generation of paired RNA expression and copy-number variation (CNV) profiles, and apply it to the longitudinal DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort. The framework assesses modality-specific fidelity and coherence between RNA and CNV pairs using agreement between real training and held-out data as a reference, alongside complementary training-data proximity diagnostics. We adapt three multi-omic integration architectures based on variational autoencoders to generate paired profiles. The model leading several fidelity and coherence measures also shows the strongest training-data proximity. The protocol and case study offer the community a reference for comparing future multi-omic generators.
zh_abstract: 配对的多组学癌症队列的构建成本高昂且难以共享，因此合成队列可作为一种补充资源。随着生成模型的开发不断加速，我们将重点从提出又一种架构转向定义评估标准，以判断合成数据是否保留了具有生物学意义的结构。我们提出了一个基于生物学信息且患者互不重叠（patient-disjoint）的框架，用于评估配对RNA表达与拷贝数变异（CNV）谱的生成，并将其应用于纵向DECIDER高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列。该框架以真实训练数据与留出数据之间的一致性作为参照，评估各模态特异的保真度以及RNA与CNV配对之间的一致性，同时辅以互补的训练数据邻近性诊断。我们改造了三种基于变分自编码器的多组学整合架构以生成配对谱。在多项保真度和一致性指标上领先的模型，同时也表现出最强的训练数据邻近性。该方案和案例研究为学界比较未来的多组学生成模型提供了参考。

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Augmentation of a Clinical Trial of a Dermo-cosmetic Intervention for Acne Remission Maintenance.
source: PubMed · Journal of drugs in dermatology : JDD
zh_title: 生成式AI增强痤疮缓解维持临床试验方案
summary: 描述一项随机安慰剂对照试验方案，使用AI生成的扩增患者数据评估护肤产品在停用异维A酸后维持痤疮缓解的效果。
key_points: 试验为随机、安慰剂对照、盲法
观察复发数与首次复发时间
用生成数据缓解招募限制
reason: 仅为试验方案，尚无结果与验证，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of drugs in dermatology : JDD] A practical application of artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare is to generate artificial datasets that capture the characteristics of a real source dataset without exposing protected health information. This approach is particularly relevant to research settings where recruitment and long-term follow-up are barriers to generating robust clinical evidence. To describe the protocol of a study incorporating augmented patient datasets to assess the efficacy of a dermo-cosmetic product (Cleanance Comedomed+®) in maintaining acne remission after discontinuation of oral isotretinoin. In a randomized, placebo-controlled, blinded clinical trial, patients will receive the dermo-cosmetic product or placebo for up to 12 months. Study outcomes are the number of observed relapses and time to first relapse. To overcome recruitment constraints and reach the 400 patients required to ensure sufficient precision for a time-dependent event criterion, a cohort augmentation strategy using artificial data is implemented. The technology relies on generative models of the Riemannian Hamiltonian Variational Autoencoder type, which learn a compact and geometrically structured latent representation of real clinical data. Generation of artificial patients will occur iteratively, and the initial dataset will be progressively enriched as new real inclusions become available. Reliability of generated data will be assessed and validated through human oversight using quantitative and qualitative metrics covering 4 dimensions: (1) statistical fidelity; (2) diversity and utility; (3) confidentiality; and (4) clinical plausibility. Structured integration of artificial data into this clinical trial illustrates the potential of generative AI as a methodological tool complementing conventional approaches in clinical research. .

title: Propagation of Low-Dose-Induced Noise Characteristics Across Deep Learning Layers in CT Imaging.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: 低剂量CT噪声特征在深度学习各层中的传播
summary: 开发可配置的图像域低剂量CT模拟工具，并用噪声功率谱分析噪声在U-Net特征层中的变化。
key_points: 可配置噪声强度与纹理的低剂量模拟
以NPS曲线下面积和中位频率量化噪声
分析预训练U-Net各层特征的噪声表现
reason: 方法学分析型研究，规模与临床证据有限
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Dose reduction in computed tomography (CT) imaging impacts diagnostic accuracy for human observers and potentially artificial intelligence (AI) systems. As noise propagates through an AI model, its characteristics change, possibly influencing model performance. This study aims to develop a configurable low-dose CT simulation tool in image-space and analyze noise behavior in deep learning (DL) layers. The noise characteristics were quantified using the noise power spectrum (NPS) within homogeneous phantom regions. NPS area under the curve (intensity) and median frequency (texture) were reported. Low-dose CT images were simulated using a custom program that was calibrated for configurable noise intensity and texture. Noise was generated at texture levels. Pre-trained U-Net features were extracted from reference and simulated low-dose images, enabling NPS-based analysis of noise propagation across deep learning layers. NPS from simulated low-dose CT images matched reference NPS for various intensity and texture values. Feature analysis revealed progressive convergence of noise characteristics across deep learning layers, with batch normalization mitigating amplification observed after convolution and ReLU activation. Differences in noise texture between low-dose simulations converge along the U-Net contracting path. The image-space simulation tool offers a viable alternative for researchers lacking access to raw data, supporting future AI-focused dose optimization studies. However, whether these outcomes translate to segmentation performance remains unclear and warrants further investigation.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）成像中的剂量降低会影响人类观察者以及潜在的人工智能（AI）系统的诊断准确性。噪声在AI模型中传播时，其特征会发生变化，可能影响模型性能。本研究旨在开发一种可配置的图像空间低剂量CT模拟工具，并分析噪声在深度学习（DL）各层中的行为。噪声特征通过均匀体模区域内的噪声功率谱（NPS）进行量化，报告了NPS曲线下面积（强度）和中位频率（纹理）。低剂量CT图像采用一款自定义程序模拟，该程序经校准后可配置噪声强度和纹理。噪声按不同纹理水平生成。从参考图像和模拟低剂量图像中提取预训练U-Net特征，从而基于NPS分析噪声在深度学习各层中的传播。模拟低剂量CT图像的NPS在多种强度和纹理取值下均与参考NPS相匹配。特征分析显示，噪声特征在深度学习各层中逐步趋于一致，批归一化可减轻卷积和ReLU激活后出现的放大现象。低剂量模拟之间的噪声纹理差异沿U-Net收缩路径趋于收敛。该图像空间模拟工具为无法获取原始数据的研究者提供了可行的替代方案，可支持未来以AI为重点的剂量优化研究。然而，这些结果是否能转化为分割性能仍不清楚，值得进一步研究。

title: SRNR: Deep learning-based MRI super-resolution using noisy high-resolution reference data.
zh_title: SRNR：利用含噪高分辨率参考的MRI超分辨率
summary: 受Noise2Noise启发提出SRNR训练范式，用含噪高分辨率图像作参考训练MRI超分辨率，在儿童与成人模拟数据上评估。
key_points: 无需高SNR高分辨率参考数据
PSNR为32.5-35.2 dB
下游图像分析性能有所改善
reason: 新训练范式但基于模拟数据，证据有限
abstract: [Imaging neuroscience (Cambridge, Mass.)] Deep learning-based super-resolution (SR) techniques offer a powerful tool to enhance the spatial resolution of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) without increasing scan time. However, most supervised SR methods rely on high-resolution, high-signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) reference data for training, which are difficult to acquire in many clinical settings, such as in time-constrained pediatric imaging. Inspired by the Noise2Noise principle, we propose SRNR, a new training paradigm that enables supervised SR using noisy high-resolution images as references. SRNR was systematically evaluated on both pediatric and adult simulated data across different noise levels of the reference data. SRNR generated super-resolved image volumes with high similarity to the high-resolution references (PSNR: 32.5-35.2 dB) and improved downstream image analysis performance, including tissue segmentation (white matter Dice coefficient: 0.951-0.960) and cortical surface reconstruction (cortical thickness absolute difference: 0.200-0.255 mm). Furthermore, SRNR was shown to be effective on clinically acquired pediatric brain MRI data, achieving improvements consistent with those observed in the simulated experiments. These results demonstrate that SRNR substantially reduces reliance on clean, high-SNR training data and enables effective SR under clinically realistic acquisition constraints, thereby improving the feasibility of deploying deep learning-based SR in pediatric MRI and related applications.

title: Artificial intelligence-driven imaging-based prediction models for hemorrhagic transformation after mechanical thrombectomy in acute ischemic stroke: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
zh_title: AI影像模型预测取栓后出血转化的系统综述与荟萃分析
summary: 系统综述并荟萃分析AI影像预测模型对急性缺血性卒中机械取栓后出血转化的预测表现。
key_points: 检索多个中英文数据库
随机效应模型合并AUC
聚焦取栓前后影像预测因子
reason: 系统综述/meta分析，摘要未见纳入规模与结论，值得一看档
abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] Hemorrhagic transformation (HT) is a major complication after mechanical thrombectomy (MT) in acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Although artificial intelligence (AI)-driven imaging-based prediction models have shown promise for predicting HT, their overall predictive performance remains uncertain. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated their predictive performance. PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang, VIP, and CBM/SinoMed were searched from inception to July 2, 2026. Studies developing or validating AI-driven imaging-based prediction models for predicting HT after MT in AIS, including both pre- and post-procedural imaging predictors, were included. A random-effects model was used to pool the area under the curve (AUC), while a bivariate random-effects model was used to jointly estimate pooled sensitivity and specificity and construct the SROC curve. Subgroup analyses explored potential sources of heterogeneity. Eleven studies (total N = 3,541) were included, 10 studies contributed eligible AUC estimates, with evaluation cohorts ranging from 18 to 261 participants. The pooled AUC was 0.891 (95% CI: 0.853-0.928), with low between-study heterogeneity (I 2 = 29.0%, p = 0.238). The bivariate random-effects model yielded a pooled sensitivity of 0.666 (95% CI: 0.578-0.744) and a pooled specificity of 0.919 (95% CI: 0.842-0.960). Exploratory subgroup analyses did not provide robust evidence supporting the superiority of any specific subgroup, and their interpretation was limited by small subgroup sizes and methodological heterogeneity. However, these findings should be interpreted cautiously because of the limited number of studies within individual subgroups. AI-driven imaging-based prediction models showed generally favorable discrimination in predicting HT after MT in AIS. However, current evidence does not establish the superiority of any specific model type. The predominance of retrospective studies, limited external validation, and methodological heterogeneity limit the generalizability of current findings. Large, multicenter prospective studies with rigorous external validation are needed before clinical implementation. The systematic review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261441463).
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] 出血转化（HT）是急性缺血性卒中（AIS）机械取栓（MT）后的主要并发症。尽管基于影像的人工智能（AI）驱动预测模型在预测HT方面显示出前景，但其总体预测性能仍不确定。本系统评价和荟萃分析评估了这些模型的预测性能。检索了PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library、Web of Science、CNKI、万方、维普以及CBM/SinoMed，检索时间从建库至2026年7月2日。纳入开发或验证基于影像的AI驱动模型以预测AIS患者MT后HT的研究，包括术前和术后影像预测因子。采用随机效应模型合并曲线下面积（AUC），采用双变量随机效应模型联合估计合并敏感度和特异度并构建SROC曲线。亚组分析探讨了异质性的潜在来源。共纳入11项研究（总N = 3,541），其中10项研究提供了可用的AUC估计值，评估队列规模为18至261例参与者。合并AUC为0.891（95% CI：0.853-0.928），研究间异质性较低（I² = 29.0%，p = 0.238）。双变量随机效应模型得出合并敏感度为0.666（95% CI：0.578-0.744），合并特异度为0.919（95% CI：0.842-0.960）。探索性亚组分析未能提供有力证据支持任何特定亚组的优越性，其解读受到亚组样本量小和方法学异质性的限制。然而，由于各亚组内研究数量有限，这些结果应谨慎解读。基于影像的AI驱动预测模型在预测AIS患者MT后HT方面总体上显示出较好的区分能力。然而，目前的证据尚不能确立任何特定模型类型的优越性。以回顾性研究为主、外部验证有限以及方法学异质性，限制了现有结果的可推广性。在临床应用之前，需要开展具有严格外部验证的大规模多中心前瞻性研究。本系统评价已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420261441463）。

title: An explainable, bias-audited machine learning model to detect hidden hepatitis C from region-wide real-world health records
zh_title: 可解释、经偏倚审计的模型：从区域电子健康记录检出隐匿丙肝
summary: 回顾性队列研究用可解释提升机，基于安达卢西亚区域健康数据库识别未诊断的丙肝感染，并在独立的2024年人群样本中评估。
key_points: 纳入25,028例丙肝与匹配对照
在独立的2024人群样本中评估
reason: 大样本回顾性，含时间独立评估，但为预印本
abstract: Background: Although direct-acting antivirals have transformed hepatitis C virus (HCV) treatment, 25-30% of active infections in Spain remain undiagnosed. We aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine-learning model to identify undiagnosed HCV infection using only data already recorded within the health system. Materials and Methods: We conducted a retrospective, population-based cohort study using the Andalusian Population Health Database (BPS). Individuals diagnosed with HCV between 2017 and 2024 (n=25,028) were matched, up to 10:1, to controls by birth year, sex, and health district. An Explainable Boosting Machine was trained on 2017-2022 data, with a threshold set in a 2023 validation set to guarantee [≥]60% sensitivity, then evaluated unmodified in an independent, non-matched, population-representative 2024 sample approximating real-world screening. Predictors comprised chronic-disease diagnoses and laboratory summary statistics recorded [≥]30 days before the index date; age and sex were excluded as matching variables. Predictors reflecting socioeconomic proxies or matching artefacts (pharmaceutical co-payment category, a zone-level deprivation index) were removed after explainability review. Results: In the independent test set, the model achieved an AUC of 0.837 (0.826 in validation), sensitivity 63.5%, specificity 91.8%, positive predictive value 7.0%, and negative predictive value 99.6%. Leading predictors were minimum alanine aminotransferase, HIV infection, dependence on non-tobacco substances, and platelet-count statistics, forming a clinically coherent, laboratory- and comorbidity-driven profile. Conclusion: An explainable model built exclusively from routine electronic health record data can identify undiagnosed HCV infection with discrimination comparable to previously published tools, evaluated under conditions approximating true population prevalence. Bias-auditing was feasible without sacrificing interpretability, supporting a scalable, equity-conscious instrument for the final phase of HCV elimination.
zh_abstract:
【背景】尽管直接抗病毒药物已改变丙型肝炎病毒（HCV）的治疗，西班牙仍有 25-30% 的活动性感染未被诊断。我们旨在仅利用卫生系统内已记录的数据，开发并验证一种可解释的机器学习模型，以识别未确诊的 HCV 感染。
【方法】我们利用安达卢西亚人群健康数据库（BPS）开展了一项回顾性、基于人群的队列研究。2017 至 2024 年间诊断为 HCV 的个体（n=25,028）按出生年份、性别和卫生区以最高 10:1 的比例与对照匹配。使用 2017-2022 年数据训练可解释提升机（Explainable Boosting Machine），在 2023 年验证集中设定阈值以保证敏感度≥60%，然后不作修改地在一个独立的、未匹配的、具有人群代表性的 2024 年样本中进行评估，以近似真实世界筛查。预测因子包括在索引日期前≥30 天记录的慢性病诊断和实验室汇总统计量；年龄和性别作为匹配变量被排除。反映社会经济替代指标或匹配伪影的预测因子（药费共付类别、区域层面的剥夺指数）在可解释性审查后被剔除。
【结果】在独立测试集中，模型的 AUC 为 0.837（验证集为 0.826），敏感度 63.5%，特异度 91.8%，阳性预测值 7.0%，阴性预测值 99.6%。主要预测因子为最低丙氨酸氨基转移酶、HIV 感染、非烟草物质依赖以及血小板计数统计量，构成了临床上一致的、以实验室检查和合并症为主导的特征。
【结论】仅利用常规电子健康记录数据构建的可解释模型，能够识别未确诊的 HCV 感染，其区分能力与既往发表的工具相当，且是在近似真实人群患病率的条件下评估的。在不牺牲可解释性的前提下开展偏倚审查是可行的，这支持将其作为 HCV 消除最后阶段的一种可扩展、兼顾公平的工具。

title: A Cross-Dataset Audit of Discrimination and Conformal Prediction Coverage in Keystroke-Based Parkinson's Disease Classi cation
zh_title: 基于击键的帕金森病分类：跨数据集判别与保形预测覆盖率审计
summary: 在4个公开数据集（475人）12个迁移方向上评估击键分类器，发现保形预测覆盖率多低于90%目标。
key_points: 主要三个方向覆盖率均低于0.90目标
Tappy→MIT覆盖率0.598，MIT→Tappy为0.850
LightGBM的AUC更低但覆盖率多数方向更高
reason: 跨数据集审计有新意，但样本小、预印本
abstract: Typing dynamics are being investigated as a digital behavioral marker for Parkinson's disease (PD), but the cross-dataset reliability of typing-based classi ers remains uncertain. We evaluated four public datasets (475 par ticipants; 270 with PD and 205 controls) across 12 transfer directions using split conformal prediction targeting 90% marginal coverage. In all three pri mary directions, coverage was below the 0.90 target and the one-sided tests remained signi cant after Holm correction: 0.598 (95% CI, 0.4830.704) for Tappy[->]MIT, 0.850 (0.7880.899) for MIT[->]Tappy, and 0.732 (0.6840.777) for clinical[->]self-reported transfer. Discrimination and coverage did not con sistently change together: LightGBM had lower AUC than logistic regression in all 12 directions but higher coverage in 11, with larger prediction sets. Class-conditional coverage varied by target cohort: PD-conditional cover age was 0.214 for Tappy[->]MIT, whereas healthy-control coverage was 0.700 for MIT[->]Tappy and 0.627 for clinical[->]self-reported transfer. Recalibration with 9 and 18 labeled target participants raised the lower condence bound above 0.80 in the latter two directions; in Tappy[->]MIT, it remained below 0.80 even with 25 labels. Weighted conformal prediction yielded coverage of 0.9181.000 without target labels but returned the full label set for 86% 100% of participants. Stress tests did not reproduce the observed coverage patterns, and black-box shift estimation did not support pure label shift as the dominant explanation for Tappy[->]MIT. Evaluating typing dynamics as a digital marker for PD requires cross-dataset assessment of discrimination, marginal and class-conditional coverage, and recovery costs. Clinical screen ing utility has not been established.
zh_abstract: 打字动力学正被作为帕金森病（PD）的一种数字行为标志物进行研究，但基于打字的分类器在不同数据集之间的可靠性仍不确定。我们使用以90%边际覆盖率为目标的分裂共形预测（split conformal prediction），在4个公开数据集（475名参与者；270名PD患者和205名对照）的12个迁移方向上进行了评估。在全部3个主要方向中，覆盖率均低于0.90的目标，且经Holm校正后单侧检验仍具有显著性：Tappy→MIT为0.598（95% CI，0.483–0.704），MIT→Tappy为0.850（0.788–0.899），临床→自报告迁移为0.732（0.684–0.777）。区分能力与覆盖率并未一致地同向变化：LightGBM在全部12个方向上的AUC均低于逻辑回归，但在11个方向上覆盖率更高，同时预测集更大。类别条件覆盖率因目标队列而异：Tappy→MIT中PD条件覆盖率为0.214，而MIT→Tappy和临床→自报告迁移中健康对照的覆盖率分别为0.700和0.627。使用9名和18名带标签的目标参与者进行重新校准后，在后两个方向上将置信下界提高到0.80以上；而在Tappy→MIT中，即使使用25个标签，其置信下界仍低于0.80。加权共形预测在无目标标签的情况下覆盖率为0.918–1.000，但对86%–100%的参与者返回了完整标签集。压力测试未能重现所观察到的覆盖率模式，黑箱偏移估计也不支持纯标签偏移是Tappy→MIT的主要解释。将打字动力学作为PD的数字标志物进行评估，需要对区分能力、边际与类别条件覆盖率以及恢复成本进行跨数据集评估。其临床筛查效用尚未确立。

title: Agentic AI enables cell segmentation-free cell-type inference and cell-type-guided cell segmentation in spatial transcriptomics
zh_title: 智能体AI实现无分割的空间转录组细胞类型推断
summary: 提出SSAF-T智能体框架，无需细胞分割和参考数据即可直接从空间基因表达推断细胞类型，并指导分割。
key_points: CeLLMan按器官设专家智能体并用知识图谱
无需预设参考数据集
在阵列与成像型空间转录组上基准测试
reason: 预印本，智能体用于生物发现，有基准但证据有限
abstract: Cell-type identification in spatial transcriptomics often relies on cell segmentation, which can introduce inaccuracies in cell boundaries and transcript assignment. Segmentation-free or cell-free methods have been developed to completely avoid cell segmentation, but inaccurate cell typing hinder accurate downstream analysis. Here, we introduce SSAF-T, a segmentation-free agentic framework that identifies cell types directly from spatial gene expression without predefined reference datasets. For the reference-free cell typing, SSAF-T incorporates CeLLMan, which employs expert-level agents for each organ to annotate cell types using a literature-grounded knowledge graph. We benchmark SSAF-T on both array-based and imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets in terms of accuracy, reproducibility, and scalability. We further show that SSAF-T provides an accurate cell segmentation based on the segmentation-free mapping, which ensure compatibility to existing downstream analysis ecosystem, and eventually enable quantitative analysis at single-cell level.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学中的细胞类型鉴定通常依赖细胞分割，而这可能导致细胞边界和转录本归属不准确。已有无分割（segmentation-free）或无细胞（cell-free）方法被开发出来以完全避免细胞分割，但不准确的细胞类型注释阻碍了准确的下游分析。在此，我们提出 SSAF-T，一种无分割的智能体（agentic）框架，可在无需预定义参考数据集的情况下直接根据空间基因表达鉴定细胞类型。对于无参考的细胞类型注释，SSAF-T 整合了 CeLLMan，后者针对每个器官采用专家级智能体，利用以文献为基础的知识图谱来注释细胞类型。我们在基于阵列和基于成像的空间转录组学数据集上，从准确性、可重复性和可扩展性方面对 SSAF-T 进行了基准测试。我们进一步表明，SSAF-T 能基于无分割映射提供准确的细胞分割，从而确保与现有下游分析生态系统的兼容性，并最终实现单细胞水平的定量分析。

title: Generative Models for Novel Enzymatic Reactions: How Far Do They Go?
zh_title: 酶促新反应的生成模型：能走多远？
summary: 预印本提出结构条件生成模型，仅从酶出发生成训练集中未出现的完整反应，并与BLASTp、CLIPZyme、RxnPred等方法比较。
key_points: BLASTp、CLIPZyme无法输出训练外反应
RxnPred在未见反应上难以精确还原
提出以结构为条件生成完整反应的模型
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，有基线对比，证据有限
abstract: Enzyme function prediction is a long-standing problem in biology, and deep learning methods have recently become popular to improve performance on this task. While most of these models focus on classifying enzymes or mapping them to known reactions, predicting unknown biochemical reactions remains underexplored. Here we thoroughly examine an approach that generates reactions absent from the training data from the enzyme alone. Existing methods such as BLASTp or CLIPZyme cannot, by design, output reactions that are absent from their training data or were not supplied at inference. The closest prior model, RxnPred, reports high fingerprint-similarity scores on held-out enzymes, a less stringent criterion than exact recovery, but fails to recover the correct answer on unseen reactions. We present a structure-conditioned generative model that outputs a complete reaction, reactants and products, and evaluate it on EnzymeMap_x, a reaction-disjoint benchmark in which no test reaction appears in training, under exact, stereo-respecting scoring. On this benchmark, within 400 sampled candidates, the model generates the complete, correct reaction for 25.0% of the subset of test enzyme--reaction pairs whose reaction is a new combination of metabolites seen in training. Surprisingly, it also correctly generates a few reactions composed of metabolites it has not seen in training (1.6%), though their embeddings are present in the vocabulary. With a lower budget, re-ranking places the correct reaction first for 5.6% of pairs and in the top ten for 12.4%, when the reaction is assumed not to be already known (0.2% and 8.1% without that assumption) along with confidence scores. Assessed more leniently, the model produces at least one correct reaction known for the enzyme (usually memorised from training) for 71.2% of test pairs. Going further, without any retraining, a sequence-only model given the reactants as well as the enzyme produces the correct product set for 9.5% of pairs within five candidates, without re-ranking. We also present head-to-head comparisons on these tasks with BLASTp, DIAMOND, RxnPred and Horizyn. Structure conditioning improves fingerprint similarity on homology-stratified splits, but a matched sequence-only ablation at the best configuration finds no measurable effect on exact recovery. Data coverage and chemical initialisation of the vocabulary seem to matter more than encoder geometry.
zh_abstract: 酶功能预测是生物学中长期存在的难题，深度学习方法近来在该任务上广受欢迎，用以提升性能。尽管这类模型大多侧重于对酶进行分类或将其映射到已知反应，但预测未知的生化反应仍未得到充分探索。在此，我们深入考察了一种仅根据酶本身生成训练数据中不存在的反应的方法。现有方法如 BLASTp 或 CLIPZyme 在设计上无法输出训练数据中不存在或推理时未提供的反应。最接近的既往模型 RxnPred 在留出酶上报告了较高的指纹相似度得分，这是一种不如精确复现严格的标准，但它无法在未见过的反应上恢复出正确答案。我们提出了一种以结构为条件的生成模型，可输出完整的反应（包括反应物和产物），并在 EnzymeMap_x 上对其进行评估；EnzymeMap_x 是一个反应不相交的基准，其中没有任何测试反应出现在训练中，评估采用精确且考虑立体化学的评分方式。在该基准上，在 400 个采样候选之内，对于测试酶–反应对中反应为训练中所见代谢物的新组合的那部分子集，该模型为其中 25.0% 生成了完整且正确的反应。令人惊讶的是，它还正确生成了少数由训练中未见过的代谢物构成的反应（1.6%），尽管这些代谢物的嵌入存在于词表中。在预算较低时，若假定反应并非已知，重排序可使正确反应在 5.6% 的酶–反应对中排在第一位、在 12.4% 中进入前十（不作该假定时分别为 0.2% 和 8.1%），同时给出置信度评分。以更宽松的方式评估，该模型在 71.2% 的测试酶–反应对中至少生成一个该酶已知的正确反应（通常是从训练中记忆而来）。更进一步，无需任何重新训练，一个仅基于序列的模型在同时获得反应物和酶的情况下，无需重排序，即可在五个候选之内为 9.5% 的酶–反应对生成正确的产物集合。我们还在这些任务上与 BLASTp、DIAMOND、RxnPred 和 Horizyn 进行了逐一对比。结构条件化在按同源性分层的数据划分上提高了指纹相似度，但在最佳配置下的匹配纯序列消融实验中，未发现其对精确复现有可测量的影响。数据覆盖度和词表的化学初始化似乎比编码器几何结构更为重要。

title: LeadWeaver: Topology-Aware Masked-Lead Modeling for Robust 12-Lead ECG Diagnosis
zh_title: LeadWeaver：面向导联缺失的拓扑感知12导联心电诊断
summary: 预印本提出LeadWeaver，通过生理导联图与掩码导联潜在补全，在导联缺失、损坏或设备偏移下进行心电诊断，在PTB-XL等设置上评估。
key_points: 以导联图耦合各导联时间标记流
可靠性路由器决定各导联诊断贡献
在PTB-XL和CPSC类设置上评估
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，基于公开数据集，证据有限
abstract: Clinical electrocardiography is organized as a structured set of correlated leads, yet most neural ECG classifiers assume that all twelve leads are present, correctly ordered, and acquired under the same device conditions at training and deployment. We propose LeadWeaver, a topology-aware ECG representation model designed for diagnosis under missing, corrupted, or device-shifted leads. LeadWeaver represents each lead as a temporal token stream, couples leads through a fixed-plus-learned physiological lead graph, and performs masked-lead latent completion rather than waveform synthesis. A reliability router estimates which observed leads should dominate each diagnostic decision, while a consistency objective aligns complete-lead and incomplete-lead predictions. We evaluate the model on PTB-XL and CPSC-style settings using complete-input diagnosis, arbitrary missing-lead subsets, lead corruption, cross-dataset transfer, calibration, and selective prediction. The central hypothesis is that robust ECG diagnosis requires explicitly modeling both inter-lead topology and uncertainty about unavailable evidence, rather than treating missing channels as zero-valued inputs.
zh_abstract: 临床心电图是由一组相互关联的导联构成的结构化信号，然而大多数神经网络心电图分类器假定十二个导联均存在、顺序正确，且在训练和部署时采集于相同的设备条件下。我们提出 LeadWeaver，一种具有拓扑感知能力的心电图表征模型，旨在用于导联缺失、受损或设备偏移情况下的诊断。LeadWeaver 将每个导联表示为时间 token 流，通过固定加可学习的生理导联图耦合各导联，并执行掩码导联的潜在表示补全，而非波形合成。可靠性路由器估计哪些已观测导联应在每次诊断决策中占主导，同时一致性目标使完整导联与不完整导联的预测相互对齐。我们在 PTB-XL 及 CPSC 类设置中评估该模型，涵盖完整输入诊断、任意缺失导联子集、导联损坏、跨数据集迁移、校准和选择性预测。核心假设是：稳健的心电图诊断需要显式建模导联间拓扑以及对不可用证据的不确定性，而不是将缺失通道视为零值输入。

title: Hierarchical Temporal Transformer for Cancer Grade Prediction and Cross-Cancer Transfer Learning from Pathology Reports
zh_title: 用于癌症分级预测与跨癌种迁移的分层时序Transformer
summary: 提出分层时序Transformer（HTT），用BiomedBERT编码病理报告并以时序模块建模；在合成基准和4786份TCGA报告上评估，含留出癌种测试。
key_points: BiomedBERT编码报告，癌种条件化时序Transformer
合成基准检验模型是否利用就诊间隔而非仅顺序
TCGA 14种癌种、3种留出，与生存模型对比
reason: 预印本新方法有基线对比，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Language models for cancer reports usually read one document at a time and are tested on tumour types seen in training. Continuous-time sequence models address the first gap, but whether they use visit timing, not just order, is seldom tested. Methods: We developed the Hierarchical Temporal Transformer (HTT), which encodes reports with adapted BiomedBERT and reads the sequence with a cancer-type-conditioned temporal transformer. We evaluated it against best-possible AUROC ceilings on two synthetic benchmarks, one with the label stated in the text and one recoverable only from tumour sizes and visit intervals (ten seeds). Diagnostics led to an interval-aware time code (HTT-IA). On 4,786 TCGA pathology reports in 14 types, three types were withheld, and a text-only HTT was compared with a survival model. Results: On the phrase benchmark HTT reached AUROC 0.931 +/- 0.012 against 0.913 +/- 0.007 for a last-report baseline (+0.018, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.050); dates cannot raise the ceiling there. On the growth benchmark the initial time code scored 0.790, equal to a no-time model (0.787), whereas HTT-IA reached 0.843 (+0.053, 0.026 to 0.082) against ceilings of 0.894 without and 0.979 with dates. On unseen tumour types HTT reached 0.925 +/- 0.007, equal to in-distribution performance and to a single-report baseline. Text-only macro C-index was 0.592 (CALM 0.626-0.652). Conclusion: Cross-type transfer is carried by the pre-trained encoder. Visit timing is used only when the data make it identifiable and the time code is on a clinical scale. zh_abstract: 【背景】癌症报告的语言模型通常一次只读取一份文档，并在训练中见过的肿瘤类型上进行测试。连续时间序列模型可以解决第一个问题，但它们是否利用了就诊时间而不仅仅是顺序，很少被检验。【方法】我们开发了分层时间Transformer（Hierarchical Temporal Transformer，HTT），它用改造后的 BiomedBERT 对报告编码，并用以癌种为条件的时间Transformer读取序列。我们在两个合成基准上，以可达到的最佳 AUROC 上限为参照对其进行评估：一个基准的标签在文本中直接陈述，另一个基准的标签只能从肿瘤大小和就诊间隔中恢复（十个随机种子）。诊断分析促成了一种感知间隔的时间编码（HTT-IA）。在涵盖14种类型的4,786份 TCGA 病理报告上，保留其中三种类型不参与训练，并将仅使用文本的 HTT 与一个生存模型进行比较。【结果】在短语基准上，HTT 的 AUROC 为 0.931 ± 0.012，末份报告基线为 0.913 ± 0.007（+0.018，95% CI −0.009 至 +0.050）；该基准中日期无法提高上限。在生长基准上，初始时间编码得分为 0.790，与无时间模型（0.787）相当，而 HTT-IA 达到 0.843（+0.053，0.026 至 0.082），对应的上限为：无日期 0.894，有日期 0.979。在未见过的肿瘤类型上，HTT 的 AUROC 为 0.925 ± 0.007，与分布内表现及单报告基线相当。仅文本的宏平均 C 指数为 0.592（CALM 为 0.626–0.652）。【结论】跨类型迁移由预训练编码器承担。只有当数据使就诊时间可被识别且时间编码处于临床尺度时，模型才会利用就诊时间。对于此类模型，性能上限、仅顺序消融和重新标注日期探测是成本低廉的检验手段。

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Patients increasingly consult artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots before clinical encounters. Existing surveys rely on patient report and cannot show whether this use is registered by the clinician. We estimated how often patient-reported pre-visit chatbot use was recorded by the treating physician as mentioned during the consultation, and examined factors associated with such a record. Prospective paired patient-clinician survey in two orthopedic outpatient clinics in North Cyprus, June to July 2026. Adults completed pre- and post-consultation forms on chatbot awareness, pre-visit chatbot use and intention to tell the physician. Physicians, instructed not to ask about chatbot use and blinded to patient forms, recorded after each consultation whether the patient had mentioned it. Anxiety and information need were measured with a study-specific, unvalidated six-item instrument and treated as exploratory. Of 350 participants, 327 (93.4%) were aware of AI chatbots and 98 (28.0%, 95% CI 23.6-32.9) had consulted one about their complaint before the visit. Physicians recorded a chatbot mention for 33 of these 98 (33.7%, 95% CI 25.1-43.5) and for 3 of 252 patients reporting no pre-visit use. The topic of the chatbot query was addressed in 77 of these consultations (patient report). A physician record was more frequent when patients had intended to tell the physician (19/31, 61.3%) than when they were undecided (12/32, 37.5%) or did not intend to (2/35, 5.7%; penalized adjusted odds ratio, intending versus not intending, 18.6, 95% CI 4.2-83.3). Other associations were imprecise. Anxiety decreased in users and aware non-users (adjusted difference 0.55 points, 95% CI -0.04 to 1.13). In this setting, two-thirds of patient-reported pre-visit chatbot use was not recorded by the physician, although the underlying topic was usually addressed. Pre-visit intention was strongly associated with a physician record. Whether a structured intake question increases recording requires prospective evaluation.
zh_abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] 患者在就诊前越来越多地咨询人工智能（AI）聊天机器人。现有调查依赖患者自我报告，无法显示这种使用是否被临床医生记录到。我们估计了患者自报的就诊前聊天机器人使用被主治医生记录为在诊疗中提及的频率，并考察了与此类记录相关的因素。这是一项在北塞浦路斯两家骨科门诊开展的前瞻性患者—临床医生配对调查，时间为2026年6月至7月。成年人在诊疗前后填写表格，内容涉及对聊天机器人的了解、就诊前聊天机器人使用情况以及是否打算告知医生。医生被要求不询问聊天机器人使用情况，且对患者表格设盲，在每次诊疗后记录患者是否提及。焦虑和信息需求采用本研究专用、未经验证的六项工具测量，并作为探索性分析。在350名参与者中，327人（93.4%）了解AI聊天机器人，98人（28.0%，95% CI 23.6–32.9）在就诊前曾就其不适咨询过聊天机器人。医生记录到提及聊天机器人的有这98人中的33人（33.7%，95% CI 25.1–43.5），以及252名自报就诊前未使用者中的3人。其中77次诊疗涉及了聊天机器人所咨询的话题（患者报告）。当患者打算告知医生时，医生记录更为常见（19/31，61.3%），高于未决定者（12/32，37.5%）和不打算告知者（2/35，5.7%；惩罚化调整后比值比，打算对比不打算，18.6，95% CI 4.2–83.3）。其他关联不够精确。使用者和了解但未使用者的焦虑均有所下降（调整后差值0.55分，95% CI −0.04至1.13）。在此情境下，患者自报的就诊前聊天机器人使用中有三分之二未被医生记录，尽管所涉及的潜在话题通常已被讨论。就诊前的意愿与医生记录密切相关。结构化的问诊登记问题是否会增加记录，需要前瞻性评估。

abstract: [Journal of the Egyptian National Cancer Institute] Cancer stem cells (CSCs) are a major contributor to therapeutic resistance, tumour recurrence, and disease progression because of their self-renewal capacity, phenotypic plasticity, immune evasion, and ability to persist after treatment. Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-based immunotherapy has transformed the treatment of several hematological malignancies, but effective targeting of CSC-driven disease, especially solid tumour, remains challenging. Antigen heterogeneity and loss, CSC plasticity, CAR-cell dysfunction, metabolic constraints, and an immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment (TME) can limit long-term therapeutic responses. CSC-associated antigens such as CD133, CD44, EpCAM, HER2, CSPG4, ALDH, and EGFRvIII have been investigated as CAR targets, although their heterogeneous and context-dependent expression raises important concerns regarding CSC specificity and on-target/off-tumour toxicity. Artificial intelligence (AI) and computational approaches provide opportunities to integrate genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, spatial, and clinical data for CSC-associated antigen discovery, biomarker identification, CAR design, patient stratification, and toxicity prediction. However, the evidence supporting these applications varies considerably, ranging from computational and preclinical studies to retrospective clinical modelling, while prospective clinical validation of AI-guided CSC-targeted CAR therapy remains limited. Similarly, next-generation platforms, including CAR-natural killer (CAR-NK) cells, CAR-macrophages (CAR-M), gamma-delta CAR-T cells, and CAR-invariant natural killer T (CAR-iNKT) cells, remain at different stages of translational development. This review critically examines CSC biology, mechanisms of resistance to CAR-based therapy, emerging CAR platforms, and the potential role of AI in precision immunogenetics. Particular emphasis is placed on differentiating CSC-intrinsic, CAR-cell-intrinsic, and TME-mediated resistance and on defining the evidence maturity of AI applications. Finally, current challenges in data availability, tumour heterogeneity, model bias, external validation, interpretability, safety, and prospective clinical translation are discussed, together with priorities for developing clinically validated AI-enabled CSC-targeted CAR therapies.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the Egyptian National Cancer Institute] 癌症干细胞（CSC）因其自我更新能力、表型可塑性、免疫逃逸以及治疗后持续存活的能力，是导致治疗耐药、肿瘤复发和疾病进展的主要因素。基于嵌合抗原受体（CAR）的免疫治疗已改变了多种血液系统恶性肿瘤的治疗，但对由 CSC 驱动的疾病，尤其是实体瘤，进行有效靶向仍具挑战。抗原异质性与丢失、CSC 可塑性、CAR 细胞功能障碍、代谢限制以及免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境（TME）均可限制长期治疗反应。CD133、CD44、EpCAM、HER2、CSPG4、ALDH 和 EGFRvIII 等 CSC 相关抗原已被研究作为 CAR 靶点，但其表达具有异质性和情境依赖性，引发了对 CSC 特异性及靶向/脱靶肿瘤外毒性（on-target/off-tumour toxicity）的重要担忧。人工智能（AI）和计算方法为整合基因组、转录组、蛋白质组、空间及临床数据，用于 CSC 相关抗原发现、生物标志物识别、CAR 设计、患者分层和毒性预测提供了机会。然而，支持这些应用的证据差异很大，从计算研究和临床前研究到回顾性临床建模不等，而 AI 指导的 CSC 靶向 CAR 治疗的前瞻性临床验证仍然有限。同样，包括 CAR-自然杀伤（CAR-NK）细胞、CAR-巨噬细胞（CAR-M）、γδ CAR-T 细胞和 CAR-恒定自然杀伤 T（CAR-iNKT）细胞在内的下一代平台，也处于转化发展的不同阶段。本综述批判性地审视了 CSC 生物学、CAR 治疗的耐药机制、新兴 CAR 平台，以及 AI 在精准免疫遗传学中的潜在作用。文中特别强调区分 CSC 内在、CAR 细胞内在和 TME 介导的耐药，并界定 AI 应用的证据成熟度。最后，讨论了当前在数据可得性、肿瘤异质性、模型偏倚、外部验证、可解释性、安全性和前瞻性临床转化方面的挑战，以及开发经临床验证的 AI 赋能 CSC 靶向 CAR 治疗的优先事项。

abstract: [Journal of microbiology & biology education] Protein-based biologics are converging at an unprecedented pace as generative artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes early-stage drug discovery. Nanobodies, single-domain antibody fragments derived from camelid heavy chain-only immunoglobulins, are an emerging class of antiviral biologics prized for their small size, stability, and access to cryptic viral epitopes. Traditional nanobody discovery relies on animal immunization and phage display screening, a process that can take 6 to 12 months and is entirely inaccessible within a standard undergraduate laboratory session. Here, we describe a succinct, in silico-based laboratory activity that uses a generative AI protein design server, GeoFlow-V3 (https://prot.design/), to allow undergraduate students to design a novel antiviral nanobody against the influenza A virus (IAV) hemagglutinin (HA) protein. This activity builds on our group's prior use of generative AI for undergraduate siRNA design teaching and extends the same pedagogical model to structural protein engineering. To our knowledge, this is the first use of a generative AI protein design platform for teaching nanobody design at the undergraduate level.
zh_abstract: [Journal of microbiology & biology education] 随着生成式人工智能（AI）重塑早期药物发现，蛋白质类生物制剂正以前所未有的速度趋于融合。纳米抗体是源自骆驼科仅含重链免疫球蛋白的单域抗体片段，是一类新兴的抗病毒生物制剂，因其体积小、稳定性高且能接近隐蔽的病毒表位而备受青睐。传统的纳米抗体发现依赖动物免疫和噬菌体展示筛选，该过程可能需要 6 至 12 个月，在标准的本科实验课时间内完全无法实现。在此，我们描述一项简明的、基于计算机模拟（in silico）的实验活动，利用生成式 AI 蛋白质设计服务器 GeoFlow-V3（https://prot.design/），使本科生能够针对甲型流感病毒（IAV）血凝素（HA）蛋白设计一种新型抗病毒纳米抗体。该活动建立在我们课题组此前将生成式 AI 用于本科 siRNA 设计教学的基础之上，并将同一教学模式扩展到结构蛋白质工程。据我们所知，这是首次在本科阶段使用生成式 AI 蛋白质设计平台来教授纳米抗体设计。

abstract: Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIABLE or SUSPICIOUS. Suspicious epochs are removed from the training set, and TinySleepNet is retrained on the cleaned data. Evaluated on the Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset using 20-fold cross-validation, our method improves overall accuracy from 81.8% to 84.6% and Macro F1-score from 75.6% to 77.4%, with particularly notable gains in REM detection. Crucially, because the LLM operates only during training, the lightweight TinySleepNet architecture (1.3M parameters) is preserved at inference, making the proposed pipeline suitable for real-time, wearable sleep monitoring applications.
zh_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）信号的自动睡眠分期是临床睡眠医学中的一项关键任务。尽管深度学习模型在该领域已显示出良好前景，但其性能从根本上受限于训练标签的质量，而这些标签由人类专家手工标注，存在评分者间不一致和系统性标注错误。本文提出了一种新颖的、由大语言模型（LLM）辅助的标签噪声过滤流程，该流程仅在训练阶段运行，用于在重新训练分类器之前识别并剔除不可靠的睡眠分期标注。具体而言，首先在原始数据集上训练 TinySleepNet，以提取每个时段（epoch）的 SoftMax 置信度分数，随后将低置信度时段连同其 EEG 频谱特征及前后序列上下文提交给 LLaMA 3.1。该 LLM 依据 AASM 睡眠评分指南对每个时段进行评估，并给出“RELIABLE（可靠）”或“SUSPICIOUS（可疑）”的判定。可疑时段从训练集中剔除，并在清理后的数据上重新训练 TinySleepNet。在 Sleep-EDF Expanded 数据集上采用 20 折交叉验证进行评估，我们的方法将总体准确率从 81.8% 提高到 84.6%，Macro F1 分数从 75.6% 提高到 77.4%，其中 REM 期检测的提升尤为显著。关键在于，由于 LLM 仅在训练阶段运行，轻量级的 TinySleepNet 架构（130 万参数）在推理时得以保留，使所提出的流程适用于实时、可穿戴的睡眠监测应用。

abstract: Robot-mediated rehabilitation has the potential to deliver high-intensity, individualized therapy, but existing systems (which have not consistently improved outcomes) typically prescribe kinematic trajectories rather than explicitly targeting the neuromotor activations thought to support recovery. To address this gap, and ultimately enable activation-optimizing rehabilitation robot behavior, we present a personalizable transformer-based model mapping individuals' muscle activations (as measured via surface electromyography) to prescribed contact force trajectories when interacting with an end-effector rehabilitation robot. The model uses a transformer encoder-decoder leveraging rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) to generate a latent representation of trajectory-relevant and user-specific neuromotor factors, and augments trajectory prediction with flow matching to produce a distribution over plausible prescriptions biased toward the training distribution. Using data from 16 healthy participants completing 15 isometric trajectory tracking tasks, we evaluate generalization across held-out tasks and users, as well as the feasibility of user-specific fine-tuning within a therapy-session timescale. The model achieves mean trajectory prediction errors of <8% on held out tasks and users, with effectively instantaneous deterministic inference and sub-second sampling of trajectory distributions. An initial test using the model during live rehabilitation tasks demonstrates that, on average, participants reach the target neuromotor activations with just 15% error accumulated throughout the task. These results provide a proof of concept for data-driven, activation-targeted trajectory prescription in robot-mediated rehabilitation and establish a foundation for future validation in clinical populations. Data and code have been open-sourced as part of the OpenRobotRehab project on SimTK.
zh_abstract: 机器人辅助康复有望提供高强度、个体化的治疗，但现有系统（并未持续改善结局）通常规定的是运动学轨迹，而非明确针对被认为有助于恢复的神经运动激活。为弥补这一不足，并最终实现以激活优化为目标的康复机器人行为，我们提出了一种可个性化的基于Transformer的模型，该模型将个体的肌肉激活（通过表面肌电图测量）映射到与末端执行器式康复机器人交互时所规定的接触力轨迹。该模型使用采用旋转位置编码（RoPE）的Transformer编码器-解码器，生成与轨迹相关且用户特异的神经运动因素的潜在表征，并通过流匹配（flow matching）增强轨迹预测，以产生偏向训练分布的合理处方分布。利用16名健康参与者完成15项等长轨迹跟踪任务的数据，我们评估了模型在留出任务和用户上的泛化能力，以及在治疗时段时间尺度内进行用户特异性微调的可行性。该模型在留出任务和用户上的平均轨迹预测误差<8%，确定性推理几乎即时完成，轨迹分布采样耗时不到1秒。在实时康复任务中使用该模型的初步测试表明，参与者平均仅以整个任务中累积的15%误差达到目标神经运动激活。这些结果为机器人辅助康复中数据驱动、以激活为目标的轨迹处方提供了概念验证，并为今后在临床人群中的验证奠定了基础。数据和代码已作为SimTK上OpenRobotRehab项目的一部分开源。

title: ToxPipe: integrating AI into toxicoinformatics.
zh_title: ToxPipe：将AI整合进毒理信息学

abstract: [Frontiers in toxicology] ToxPipe is a modular, fully open-source software stack designed to accelerate toxicological data analysis and decision-making by integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities with workflow, monitoring, and user-interface services. ToxPipe leverages existing open-source technologies like LibreChat, LiteLLM, and Langflow to provide centralized and streamlined access to different LLMs for end users and developers and logging and auditing of LLM use for organizations. ToxPipe also allows for open-source/local model support. While the ToxPipe ecosystem also supports advanced AI functions such as MCP server integration, RAG and literature search, and agent creation, we did not observe clear benefits using these configurations relative to the GPT-5.5 baseline assertion coverage scores. ToxPipe is available as a series of Docker containers for rapid and reproducible deployment.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in toxicology] ToxPipe 是一个模块化、完全开源的软件栈，旨在通过将大语言模型（LLM）能力与工作流、监控和用户界面服务相集成，加速毒理学数据分析与决策。ToxPipe 利用现有的开源技术（如 LibreChat、LiteLLM 和 Langflow），为终端用户和开发者提供对不同 LLM 的集中、简化的访问，并为各机构提供 LLM 使用的日志记录和审计。ToxPipe 还支持开源/本地模型。尽管 ToxPipe 生态系统也支持高级人工智能功能，如 MCP 服务器集成、RAG 与文献检索以及智能体（agent）创建，但相对于 GPT-5.5 基线的断言覆盖率得分，我们未观察到使用这些配置带来明确的益处。ToxPipe 以一系列 Docker 容器的形式提供，可实现快速且可重复的部署。

title: Artificial intelligence for vascular minimally invasive surgery: techniques, clinical integration, and challenges.
zh_title: 血管微创手术中的人工智能：技术、临床整合与挑战
summary: 一篇综述，分析30项将AI用于血管微创手术的原始研究，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、NLP与机器人/强化学习，并讨论临床转化、监管与伦理。

abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] Minimally invasive surgery (MIS), including endovascular and robot-assisted procedures, is widely used for vascular pathologies but remains limited by technical complexity, cognitive workload, and postoperative complications. Artificial Intelligence (AI) may help address these challenges through predictive analysis, decision support, image analysis, and automation. A structured Google Scholar search was conducted from February 21, 2025, to January 1, 2026, and updated through September 2026. Peer-reviewed studies applying AI to vascular MIS were included, with additional targeted searches addressing clinical translation, deployment, regulation, and ethical considerations. Thirty primary studies were analyzed, including eight on machine learning, nine on deep learning, four on natural language processing, and nine on robotics or reinforcement learning. Machine learning supported risk stratification and outcome prediction, deep learning enabled imaging and segmentation applications, natural language processing facilitated clinical information extraction, and robotic systems supported navigation and procedural assistance. AI demonstrates substantial potential across the vascular MIS pathway, but broader clinical adoption requires stronger validation, prospective multicenter studies, standardized reporting, health-economic evaluation, and careful consideration of regulatory, liability, and accessibility challenges.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] 微创手术（MIS），包括血管内手术和机器人辅助手术，已广泛用于血管病变，但仍受限于技术复杂性、认知负荷和术后并发症。人工智能（AI）可能通过预测分析、决策支持、图像分析和自动化来帮助应对这些挑战。我们于2025年2月21日至2026年1月1日进行了结构化的 Google Scholar 检索，并更新至2026年9月。纳入将 AI 应用于血管微创手术的同行评审研究，并另行开展有针对性的检索，涉及临床转化、部署、监管和伦理考量。共分析了30项原始研究，其中机器学习8项、深度学习9项、自然语言处理4项、机器人或强化学习9项。机器学习支持风险分层和结局预测，深度学习实现了影像和分割应用，自然语言处理有助于临床信息提取，机器人系统支持导航和手术辅助。AI 在血管微创手术全流程中显示出巨大潜力，但要实现更广泛的临床应用，需要更强的验证、前瞻性多中心研究、标准化报告、卫生经济学评价，并需审慎考虑监管、责任归属和可及性方面的挑战。

title: Overcoming subject variability in P300 decoding based on quantification by deep learning.
zh_title: 基于深度学习量化的P300解码中被试变异性应对
summary: 提出SQ_EMoE混合专家框架，用被试识别网络置信度将试次路由至被试专用或通用专家，以应对脑电P300解码的被试差异。
key_points: 以被试识别置信度作为试次区分度代理
高置信试次交给被试专家，不确定的交给通用专家
对潜在被试表征做了可视化
reason: 脑电解码新方法，摘要未见大规模外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in neuroscience] Binary P300 decoding is a cornerstone of P300-based brain-computer interfaces, enabling applications such as assistive communication, neurorehabilitation, and cognitive monitoring. However, substantial subject variability in EEG patterns poses a major challenge to the development of generalized P300 decoders. To address this problem, this study proposes SQ_EMoE, a subject-variability-aware enhanced Mixture-of-Experts framework that uses the confidence produced by a deep subject-identification network as a practical proxy for trial-level subject distinctiveness. High-confidence trials are routed to subject-specific experts, whereas uncertain trials are redirected to a pooled general expert, allowing the framework to dynamically balance subject-specific specialization and cross-subject generalization. Latent subject representations are further visualized to qualitatively examine subject separability and its relationship with routing behavior. Experiments on eight random subjects from each of two public P300 datasets yielded mean ROC-AUC values of approximately 0.86 on BNCI Horizon 2020 and 0.89 on P300-LINI, outperforming pooled EEGNet and architecture-matched pooled P300MCNN baselines. Ablation experiments further demonstrated the contribution of confidence-controlled fallback to the general expert. To evaluate scalability, the framework was additionally tested on all 22 subjects of P300-LINI. With the original subject-identification network, SQ_EMoE achieved a mean ROC-AUC of 0.8518; after strengthening the subject representation and identification network, performance increased to 0.8760, exceeding the pooled P300MCNN baseline (0.8482) and slightly surpassing the oracle routing or within-subject decoding (0.8744). Leave-one-subject-out experiments further showed that the under-realized SQ_EMoE conservatively redirects most completely unseen-subject trials to the general expert when reliable subject-specific routing is unavailable. These results demonstrate that effective modeling of subject variability, together with adaptive integration of shared and subject-specific representations, provides a promising alternative to conventional one-size-fits-all EEG decoding.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in neuroscience] 二分类 P300 解码是基于 P300 的脑机接口的基石，可用于辅助交流、神经康复和认知监测等应用。然而，脑电图（EEG）模式中显著的受试者间变异性，对通用 P300 解码器的开发构成重大挑战。为解决这一问题，本研究提出 SQ_EMoE，一种感知受试者变异性的增强型专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）框架，其以深度受试者识别网络产生的置信度作为试次层面受试者独特性的实用替代指标。高置信度试次被路由至受试者特异性专家，而不确定的试次则被重新导向汇总的通用专家，使该框架能够动态平衡受试者特异性专门化与跨受试者泛化。研究还进一步对潜在受试者表示进行可视化，以定性考察受试者可分性及其与路由行为的关系。在两个公开 P300 数据集中各随机选取八名受试者进行的实验中，BNCI Horizon 2020 上的平均 ROC-AUC 约为 0.86，P300-LINI 上约为 0.89，优于汇总训练的 EEGNet 和架构匹配的汇总训练 P300MCNN 基线。消融实验进一步证明了向通用专家进行置信度控制回退的贡献。为评估可扩展性，该框架还在 P300-LINI 的全部 22 名受试者上进行了测试。使用原始受试者识别网络时，SQ_EMoE 的平均 ROC-AUC 为 0.8518；在强化受试者表示和识别网络后，性能提升至 0.8760，超过汇总训练的 P300MCNN 基线（0.8482），并略高于理想路由（oracle routing）或受试者内解码（0.8744）。留一受试者交叉验证实验进一步表明，在缺乏可靠的受试者特异性路由时，未充分实现的 SQ_EMoE 会保守地将大多数完全未见过的受试者试次重新导向通用专家。这些结果表明，对受试者变异性进行有效建模，并自适应地整合共享表示与受试者特异性表示，为传统“一刀切”的 EEG 解码提供了一种有前景的替代方案。

title: Digital behavioural data should inform mental health screening.
zh_title: 数字行为数据应辅助心理健康筛查

abstract: [BJPsych bulletin] Digital behavioural data from smartphones, wearables and artificial intelligence-enabled systems are increasingly available alongside mental health screening questionnaires. However, there is limited guidance on when such signals are appropriate for mental health screening contexts and how they should be interpreted without overreach into diagnosis. We outline four principles (detectable change, context, informing timing and sustained utility) to guide how digital data can inform interpretation and follow-up while preserving the role of validated screening instruments.
zh_abstract: [BJPsych bulletin] 来自智能手机、可穿戴设备和人工智能系统的数字行为数据，正越来越多地与心理健康筛查问卷并行获得。然而，对于此类信号何时适用于心理健康筛查场景，以及如何在不过度延伸至诊断的前提下对其进行解读，目前指导有限。我们提出四项原则（可检测的变化、情境、提示时机和持续效用），以指导数字数据如何为解读和随访提供信息，同时保留经过验证的筛查工具的作用。

title: ProtoGestalt: Interpretable Prototypes for Facial Phenotyping and Diagnosis of Rare Genetic Disorders
zh_title: ProtoGestalt：用于罕见遗传病面部表型与诊断的可解释原型
summary: 预印本提出基于原型学习的可解释框架，将视觉特征限制于特定面部区域，用于罕见病筛查与综合征识别。
key_points: 以局部、可加性证据解释预测
在多个对照数据集上评估筛查能力
评估已训练综合征的诊断表现
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要中证据有限
abstract: Rare genetic disorders are difficult to diagnose due to their diversity and overlapping clinical features. Facial morphology can provide diagnostic clues, yet most diagnostic models offer limited interpretability and are not designed to support broad screening for undiagnosed disease. We present ProtoGestalt, an interpretable prototype-based framework for facial phenotyping, rare-disease screening, and syndrome identification. The method extends prototype learning by constraining learned visual features to select facial regions, allowing predictions to be explained through localized and additive evidence. We assess ProtoGestalt's ability to distinguish syndromic from unaffected faces on multiple control datasets and class prevalence values. We further evaluate it's diagnostic performance on syndromes observed during training. The learned prototype-based representations provide significant separation between syndromic and case-matched control images and retain useful performance as the proportion of controls increases. The framework also demonstrates the ability to differentiate among syndromes. Although reasonably accurate specialized models for facial classification of rare disorders already exist, ProtoGestalt offers an interpretable alternative that links predictions to anatomically meaningful facial regions, potentially supporting clinical decision-making and the discovery of phenotype-gene associations.
zh_abstract: 罕见遗传病由于其多样性和临床特征重叠而难以诊断。面部形态可为诊断提供线索，但大多数诊断模型的可解释性有限，且并非为支持对未确诊疾病的广泛筛查而设计。我们提出 ProtoGestalt，一种基于原型的可解释框架，用于面部表型分析、罕见病筛查和综合征识别。该方法扩展了原型学习，将所学视觉特征限定于选定的面部区域，使预测可通过局部化且可加的证据加以解释。我们在多个对照数据集和不同类别患病率下，评估了 ProtoGestalt 区分综合征面孔与未受影响面孔的能力。我们还进一步评估了其对训练期间见过的综合征的诊断性能。所学的基于原型的表征在综合征图像与病例匹配的对照图像之间提供了显著的区分，并且随着对照比例的增加仍保持有用的性能。该框架还展示了区分不同综合征的能力。尽管已有较为准确的用于罕见病面部分类的专用模型，ProtoGestalt 提供了一种可解释的替代方案，将预测与具有解剖学意义的面部区域相联系，有望支持临床决策以及表型-基因关联的发现。

title: GTAFL: Addressing Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning in Medical Image
zh_title: GTAFL：医学图像中测试分布未知的长尾联邦学习
summary: 提出测试分布未知的长尾联邦学习新任务及GTAFL框架，面向医疗数据的长尾分布与隐私保护场景。
key_points: 提出Test-Agnostic长尾联邦学习任务
针对医疗数据本地与全局长尾分布
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 新任务设定的预印本，摘要无更多证据，增量档
abstract: In healthcare, protecting patient privacy is crucial due to the sensitivity of medical data and its extensive accessibility. Federated Learning (FL) offers a decentralized and privacy-preserving training paradigm, making it an ideal solution for healthcare applications. A critical challenge in healthcare is that real-world medical data often exhibits long-tailed distributions in local and global views. Existing methods addressing long-tailed FL problem typically assume that the model will be evaluated on uniform test data distribution. However, practical test data in healthcare systems is often agnostic and unpredictable, leading to potential model failures in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we introduce a novel task termed Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning and propose GTAFL, a comprehensive framework to address this challenge. During the training stage, GTAFL employs adaptive re-sampling, expert classifier retraining, and self-supervised learning to correct biased classifiers and distorted feature spaces caused by long-tailed training distributions. During the inference stage, an ensemble mechanism combines retrained expert classifiers to handle test data with unknown distributions. Extensive experiments on CIFAR10 and two medical datasets manifest that our framework outperforms other state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/cgy-lavine/GTAFL
zh_abstract: 在医疗健康领域，由于医疗数据的敏感性及其广泛的可获取性，保护患者隐私至关重要。联邦学习（FL）提供了一种去中心化且保护隐私的训练范式，是医疗应用的理想解决方案。医疗领域的一个关键挑战是，真实世界的医疗数据在局部和全局视角下往往呈现长尾分布。现有解决长尾联邦学习问题的方法通常假定模型将在均匀的测试数据分布上进行评估。然而，医疗系统中的实际测试数据往往是未知且不可预测的，可能导致模型在真实场景中失效。本文提出了一项称为“测试无关长尾联邦学习”（Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning）的新任务，并提出 GTAFL，一个应对这一挑战的综合框架。在训练阶段，GTAFL 采用自适应重采样、专家分类器重训练和自监督学习，以纠正长尾训练分布导致的有偏分类器和扭曲的特征空间。在推理阶段，一种集成机制将重训练后的专家分类器结合起来，以处理分布未知的测试数据。在 CIFAR10 和两个医学数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的框架优于其他最先进的方法。代码见 https://github.com/cgy-lavine/GTAFL

title: Contrastive Learning Improves Generalization on M2OR Olfactory Binding Dataset
zh_title: 对比学习提升M2OR嗅觉结合数据集的泛化能力
summary: 预印本在M2OR和iOBPdb数据集上评估不同数据划分方式，并用神经网络与对比学习框架预测VOC-嗅觉受体结合的泛化表现。
key_points: 任务为挥发性有机物与嗅觉受体结合预测
评估多种数据划分方法对泛化的影响
采用神经网络与对比学习框架

abstract: Olfaction-based biosensors stand to have profound impacts in fields such as medical diagnostics, national security, and drug discovery. A promising mode of vapor phase biodetection mimics volatile organic compound-olfactory receptor (VOC-OR) interactions with target-specific protein or peptide probes; however, lack of experimental coverage remains a core bottleneck. Current computational approaches aim to improve prediction of VOC-OR binding to reduce experimental burden, and current machine learning approaches fail to demonstrate a level of generalization that addresses current engineering challenges. Here, using the Molecular to Olfactory Dataset (M2OR) and Insect Olfactory Binding Protein Database (iOBPdb) datasets, data partitioning methods and their performance are evaluated on a neural network and contrastive learning framework on such VOC-OR binding datasets, varying: model training, architecture, and structure of the input data distribution. It was found that holding out certain chemical or proteomic motifs from the training data diminished model performance with a two layer neural network model. The model was able to generalize to state of the art performance (0.88 AUCROC) on every data split by applying a contrastive learning objective defined by shared molecular constituents and a stochastic sampler. This suggests the contrastive objective provides a strong inductive bias for neural networks to predict novel VOC-OR pairs. These findings highlight that model performance on pairwise biological interaction datasets can be inflated through identity leakage from constituent overlap, and emphasize the need for more robust evaluation protocols. Furthermore, we show contrastive regularization mitigates dataset degeneracy through enforcement of compatibility in the models latent geometry that may extend to other binder target-datasets where identity leakage confounds evaluation.
zh_abstract: 基于嗅觉的生物传感器有望在医学诊断、国家安全和药物发现等领域产生深远影响。一种有前景的气相生物检测模式是用靶标特异性的蛋白或肽探针模拟挥发性有机化合物-嗅觉受体（VOC-OR）相互作用；然而，实验覆盖不足仍是核心瓶颈。目前的计算方法旨在改进对 VOC-OR 结合的预测以减轻实验负担，而现有的机器学习方法所表现出的泛化水平尚不足以应对当前的工程挑战。本文利用分子-嗅觉数据集（Molecular to Olfactory Dataset，M2OR）和昆虫嗅觉结合蛋白数据库（Insect Olfactory Binding Protein Database，iOBPdb）数据集，在此类 VOC-OR 结合数据集上，基于神经网络和对比学习框架评估了数据划分方法及其表现，并改变了模型训练、架构以及输入数据分布的结构。结果发现，在训练数据中留出某些化学或蛋白质组基序，会降低双层神经网络模型的性能。通过应用由共有分子成分定义的对比学习目标和随机采样器，该模型能够在每一种数据划分上泛化并达到当前最优性能（AUCROC 0.88）。这表明对比目标为神经网络预测新的 VOC-OR 配对提供了强有力的归纳偏置。这些发现凸显出，成对生物相互作用数据集上的模型性能可能因成分重叠造成的身份泄漏而被高估，并强调需要更稳健的评估方案。此外，我们表明对比正则化通过在模型潜在几何中强制实现兼容性来缓解数据集的退化问题，这可能适用于其他身份泄漏会干扰评估的结合物-靶标数据集。

title: Organotchi: an open-source tool for the automated segmentation, morphological characterization, and longitudinal tracking of organoids

abstract: Neural organoids are three-dimensional stem cell-derived models widely used to study brain development and model disease. Brightfield imaging offers a non-invasive readout of their growth and morphology, and recent advances have made automated organoid segmentation from such images increasingly attainable. Yet existing tools largely leave morphological characterization, quality assessment, and comparisons between conditions to manual or ad hoc analysis. Here we present Organotchi, an open-source tool that integrates automated segmentation with longitudinal morphological analysis of neural organoids. Organotchi quantifies ten morphological features, including area, perimeter, and eccentricity, and tracks cystic structures over time, reports variability within and between batches, and flags outlier organoids and segmentation failures, supporting objective organoid characterization and enhancing downstream analysis. As a proof of concept, we apply Organotchi to disease modelling, pharmacological perturbation, and protocol optimization in neural organoids. One use case assesses drug response in breast cancer spheroids, demonstrating its use beyond its development domain.

abstract: Timecourse single-cell RNA (scRNA) datasets have become indispensable biological tools for studying and uncovering the underlying regulatory processes driving continuous cell-state transitions such as the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition. However, these highly fluid, non-linear gene program dynamics remain difficult to disentangle. While deep neural network models can effectively map complex topologies, they are biological black boxes, lacking the gene-level interpretability required by experimental practitioners. Here, we introduce scCont, a fully unsupervised contrastive learning framework for extracting interpretable functional transition units from scRNA-seq data. Rather than relying on explicit temporal labels or clustering priors, scCont uses an unsupervised k-nearest neighbors approach to project local transcriptomic neighborhoods into a low-dimensional embedding. During post-training analysis, scCont employs Shapley network attribution to determine gene-latent relationships, mapping latent dimensions directly into functional gene programs. We quantitatively and qualitatively validate this representation by demonstrating that scCont captures biologically interpretable dynamics more effectively than baseline methods such as LDVAE. Evaluated across 13 diverse EMT timecourse datasets and four simulated datasets, scCont exposes interpretable functional dynamics and effectively maps context-dependent functional groups, helping to bridge the gap between deep learning representation and translational biological utility. scCont is an open source software available on GitHub (https://github.com/nramani611/scCont).
zh_abstract: 时间进程单细胞 RNA（scRNA）数据集已成为研究和揭示驱动连续细胞状态转变（如上皮-间充质转化）的潜在调控过程不可或缺的生物学工具。然而，这些高度流动、非线性的基因程序动态仍难以厘清。深度神经网络模型虽能有效映射复杂拓扑结构，但属于生物学上的“黑箱”，缺乏实验研究者所需的基因层面的可解释性。在此，我们提出 scCont，一种完全无监督的对比学习框架，用于从 scRNA-seq 数据中提取可解释的功能转变单元。scCont 不依赖明确的时间标签或聚类先验，而是采用无监督的 k 近邻方法将局部转录组邻域投影到低维嵌入中。在训练后分析中，scCont 利用 Shapley 网络归因来确定基因与潜在变量之间的关系，将潜在维度直接映射为功能性基因程序。我们通过定量和定性方式验证了这一表征，证明 scCont 比 LDVAE 等基线方法更有效地捕捉到具有生物学可解释性的动态。在13个不同的 EMT 时间进程数据集和4个模拟数据集上的评估表明，scCont 能够揭示可解释的功能动态，并有效映射依赖上下文的功能组，有助于弥合深度学习表征与转化生物学应用之间的差距。scCont 是开源软件，可在 GitHub 获取（https://github.com/nramani611/scCont）。

abstract: Quantum annealing (QA) has been explored as an approach for protein design in vast combinatorial sequence spaces. Applying QA to protein sequence design requires amino acid sequences to be encoded as binary vectors, and optimized vectors to be decoded back into amino acid sequences. Thus, both the quality of binary encoding and sequence reconstruction accuracy are important for effective QA-based optimization. Binary variational autoencoder (bVAE) has been used to map protein sequences to binary representations in QA-based protein sequence design. However, bVAE was originally developed for natural language modeling, and its suitability for proteins has not been systematically evaluated. Here, we present pLM-bVAE, which incorporates protein representations derived from a pretrained protein language model (pLM) into the original bVAE model. In computational experiments on three public protein variant datasets, pLM-bVAE showed higher sequence reconstruction accuracy and binary encoding performance than bVAE. Moreover, we incorporated pLM-bVAE into a QA-based protein sequence design framework. Across all three datasets, pLM-bVAE generated more high-scoring sequences with greater sequence dissimilarity from the training and validation data than bVAE. Our results demonstrate that pLM-bVAE provides an effective binary representation for improving QA-based protein sequence design. Availability The source code used in this manuscript is available at https://github.com/hueda8/pLM-bVAE.
zh_abstract: 量子退火（QA）已被探索用于庞大组合序列空间中的蛋白质设计。将QA应用于蛋白质序列设计，需要将氨基酸序列编码为二值向量，并将优化后的向量解码回氨基酸序列。因此，二值编码的质量和序列重建的准确性对于有效的基于QA的优化都很重要。二值变分自编码器（bVAE）已被用于在基于QA的蛋白质序列设计中将蛋白质序列映射为二值表示。然而，bVAE最初是为自然语言建模而开发的，其对蛋白质的适用性尚未得到系统评估。在此，我们提出pLM-bVAE，它将来自预训练蛋白质语言模型（pLM）的蛋白质表示纳入原始bVAE模型。在三个公开蛋白质变体数据集上的计算实验中，pLM-bVAE显示出比bVAE更高的序列重建准确性和二值编码性能。此外，我们将pLM-bVAE纳入基于QA的蛋白质序列设计框架。在所有三个数据集中，pLM-bVAE相比bVAE生成了更多高分序列，且与训练和验证数据的序列差异更大。我们的结果表明，pLM-bVAE提供了一种有效的二值表示，可改进基于QA的蛋白质序列设计。可用性：本文所用源代码见 https://github.com/hueda8/pLM-bVAE。

abstract: [Early human development] Early identification of language development delays in preschool children enables timely intervention during critical developmental windows, yet existing screening tools rely on periodic snapshots that miss the dynamic, trajectory-based nature of language acquisition. This study presents a multimodal deep learning framework - a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory network with multi-head attention - for predicting individual language development trajectories from birth to 24 months using acoustic, linguistic, and behavioral feature streams collected in naturalistic early educational environments. Trained on 6349 longitudinal assessments from 847 children across three collection sites, the model achieves a mean absolute error of 4.2 score points, R2 = 0.93, and an AUC-ROC of 0.94 for language delay classification. Ablation experiments confirm that multimodal fusion outperforms any single modality, with linguistic features contributing the largest marginal gain. The model accurately identifies children with language delay risk at 12 months with 84% sensitivity and 92% specificity, outperforming standard clinical screening instruments on specificity while maintaining comparable sensitivity. Subgroup analyses confirm consistent performance across socioeconomic, bilingual, and gender-based subgroups. Feature importance analysis reveals that early acoustic features dominate prediction in the first six months, while linguistic and behavioral features grow in importance across development. Practical implementation guidelines are provided for deployment in preschool and early educational settings.

abstract: [The Linacre quarterly] The role of artificial intelligence (AI) in medicine should be discussed following Pope Leo XIV's recent encyclical on AI and the need to protect human dignity in this era of advancing technology. As a result of its efficiency and accessibility to people for medical advice, AI is already starting to change healthcare. These advances may improve patient care, but medicine is about more than access to information. Medicine is a vocation motivated by the compassionate service to others, and this must be defended. Using the teachings of Antiqua et Nova and Magnifica Humanitas as a guide, this commentary discusses how Catholic bioethics can contribute to the integration of AI in clinical practice. These ethical principles can direct the proper use of AI while still upholding physicians' responsibilities to their patients. Physicians must recognize each patient's dignity and needs, which go beyond the knowledge that any algorithm can offer. Furthermore, the recommendations that these AI systems provide are only as strong as the information available to them, emphasizing the continued importance of the physician's clinical judgment. As we continue to monitor the emergence and growth of AI, the Church serves as a reminder to us that AI should support physicians' clinical judgment while preserving the sacred relationship of trust between physician and patient.

abstract: This study evaluates the added prognostic value of day-1 multimodal MRI for predicting three-month functional outcome after acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Sixty-six AIS patients with ADC, DWI, FLAIR, and clinical data were analyzed. Three-dimensional pretrained ResNet embeddings were extracted from each MRI modality, reduced using fold-isolated principal component analysis, and combined with structured clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers. Linear support vector machines were evaluated using eight-fold stratified group cross-validation across MRI modality combinations. Clinical-only modeling achieved strong performance (AUC = $0.899 \pm 0.151$), while MRI-only models showed limited discrimination (AUC $\approx$ $0.67$-$0.73$). Among multimodal configurations, FLAIR-clinical fusion achieved the highest mean cross-validated performance (AUC = $0.948 \pm 0.061$), followed by ADC-clinical fusion (AUC = $0.941 \pm 0.094$). Full ADC-DWI-FLAIR fusion did not consistently outperform single-modality clinical fusion. Feature-importance analysis identified age, NIHSS subscores, ADC lesion burden, and learned FLAIR representations as key contributors, while qualitative FLAIR activation maps showed responses over lesion-like regions. These findings suggest that compact day-1 FLAIR and ADC representations provide complementary prognostic information beyond clinical variables and support interpretable, data-efficient outcome prediction in AIS.
